title.zh: 卷28 志第23 百官下
title.raw: 卷28 志第23 百官下 Volume 28 Treatises 23: Government Offices 3

sentences.zh: 百官下

translations.literal: Government Offices, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: Government Offices, Part Two

sentences.zh: 高祖既受命，改周之六官，其所制名，多依前代之法。

translations.literal: After the High Ancestor received the Mandate, he changed the Northern Zhou's six-ministry system; the names he established largely followed the methods of previous dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Gaozu received the Mandate, he replaced the Northern Zhou six-ministry system. The office titles he established largely followed the precedents of earlier dynasties.

sentences.zh: 置三師、三公及尚書、門下、內史、秘書、內侍等省，御史、都水等台，太常、光祿、衛尉、宗正、太僕、大理、鴻臚、司農、太府、國子、將作等寺，左右衛、左右武衛、左右武候、左右領、左右監門、左右領軍等府，分司統職焉。

translations.literal: He established the Three Preceptors and Three Dukes, as well as the Departments of the Secretariat, Chancellery, Palace Secretariat, Imperial Library, and Palace Domestic Service; the Bureaus of the Censorate and Directorate of Waterways; the Courts of Imperial Sacrifices, Imperial Household, Guard Commandant, Imperial Clan, Imperial Stud, Court of Judicial Review, Court of State Ceremonial, Court of the National Granaries, Court of the Imperial Treasury, Directorate of Education, and Directorate of Palace Construction; and the Guard Commands of the Left and Right Guards, Left and Right Martial Guards, Left and Right Martial Patrol, Left and Right Command, Left and Right Gate Guards, and Left and Right Army Command—each division supervising its own duties.
translations.idiomatic: He established the Three Preceptors and Three Dukes, along with the Secretariat, Chancellery, Palace Secretariat, Imperial Library, and Palace Domestic Service departments; the Censorate and Directorate of Waterways bureaus; the Imperial Sacrifices, Imperial Household, Guard Commandant, Imperial Clan, Imperial Stud, Judicial Review, State Ceremonial, National Granaries, Imperial Treasury, Education, and Palace Construction courts; and the Left and Right Guards, Martial Guards, Martial Patrol, Command, Gate Guards, and Army Command guard offices—each division supervising its own duties.

sentences.zh: 三師，不主事，不置府僚，蓋與天子坐而論道者也。

translations.literal: The Three Preceptors did not administer affairs and had no office staff; they were essentially those who sat with the Son of Heaven to discuss the Way.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Preceptors did not administer affairs and had no office staff; they were essentially counselors who sat with the emperor to discuss the Way.

sentences.zh: 三公，參議國之大事，依後齊置府僚。

translations.literal: The Three Dukes deliberated on the great affairs of the state and, following Northern Qi practice, had office staff appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Dukes deliberated on the great affairs of the state and, following Northern Qi practice, were given office staff.

sentences.zh: 無其人則闕。

translations.literal: When there was no suitable person, the post was left vacant.
translations.idiomatic: When no suitable person could be found, the post was left vacant.

sentences.zh: 祭祀則太尉亞獻，司徒奉俎，司空行掃除。

translations.literal: At sacrifices, the Grand Commandant performed the secondary offering, the Minister over the Masses presented the sacrificial meat, and the Minister of Works carried out the sweeping and cleaning.
translations.idiomatic: At sacrifices, the Grand Commandant performed the secondary offering, the Minister over the Masses presented the sacrificial meat, and the Minister of Works carried out the sweeping and cleaning.

sentences.zh: 其位多曠，皆攝行事。

translations.literal: Their posts were often vacant, and others were appointed to act in their stead.
translations.idiomatic: Their posts were often vacant, and others were appointed to act in their stead.

sentences.zh: 尋省府及僚佐，置公則坐于尚書都省。

translations.literal: Soon the offices and their subordinates were abolished; when a Duke was appointed, he sat in the Secretariat's Central Department.
translations.idiomatic: Soon those offices and their subordinates were abolished; when a Duke was appointed, he took his seat in the Secretariat's Central Department.

sentences.zh: 朝之眾務，總歸於台閣。

translations.literal: The multitude of court affairs all reverted to the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: The multitude of court affairs all reverted to the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 尚書省，事無不總。

translations.literal: The Department of the Secretariat: nothing in its affairs went unhandled.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of the Secretariat: nothing in its affairs went unhandled.

sentences.zh: 置令、左右僕射各一人，總吏部、禮部、兵部、都官、度支、工部等六曹事，是為八座。

translations.literal: It had one Director and one Left and one Right Vice Director, who together oversaw the affairs of the six bureaus—Personnel, Rites, War, Justice, Revenue, and Public Works—these being the Eight Seats.
translations.idiomatic: It had one Director and one Left and one Right Vice Director, who together oversaw the affairs of the six bureaus—Personnel, Rites, War, Justice, Revenue, and Public Works—these being the Eight Seats.

sentences.zh: 屬官左、右丞各一人，都事八人，分司管轄，吏部尚書統吏部侍郎二人，主爵侍郎一人，司勳侍郎二人，考功侍郎一人。

translations.literal: Subordinate officials were one Left and one Right Assistant Director and eight Chief Clerks, who divided supervision; the Minister of Personnel oversaw two Vice Ministers of Personnel, one Vice Minister of Nobility, two Vice Ministers of Merits, and one Vice Minister of Evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate officials were one Left and one Right Assistant Director and eight Chief Clerks, who divided supervision; the Minister of Personnel oversaw two Vice Ministers of Personnel, one Vice Minister of Nobility, two Vice Ministers of Merits, and one Vice Minister of Evaluation.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書統禮部、祠部侍郎各一人，主客、膳部侍郎各二人。

translations.literal: The Minister of Rites oversaw one Vice Minister of Rites and one Vice Minister of Sacrifices, and two Vice Ministers of Receiving Guests and two Vice Ministers of Provisions each.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Rites oversaw one Vice Minister of Rites and one Vice Minister of Sacrifices, and two Vice Ministers each of Receiving Guests and Provisions.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書統兵部、職方侍郎各二人，駕部、庫部侍郎各一人。

translations.literal: The Minister of War oversaw two Vice Ministers of War and two Vice Ministers of Bureau of Appointments, and one Vice Minister of Imperial Carriages and one Vice Minister of Armory each.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of War oversaw two Vice Ministers of War and two Vice Ministers of Bureau of Appointments, and one Vice Minister each of Imperial Carriages and Armory.

sentences.zh: 都官尚書統都官侍郎二人，刑部、比部侍郎各一人，司門侍郎二人。

translations.literal: The Minister of Justice oversaw two Vice Ministers of Justice, one Vice Minister of Punishments and one Vice Minister of Review, and two Vice Ministers of Gatekeeping.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Justice oversaw two Vice Ministers of Justice, one Vice Minister of Punishments and one Vice Minister of Review, and two Vice Ministers of Gatekeeping.

sentences.zh: 度支尚書統度支、戶部侍郎各二人，金部、倉部侍郎各一人。

translations.literal: The Minister of Revenue oversaw two Vice Ministers of Revenue and two Vice Ministers of Households, and one Vice Minister of Treasury and one Vice Minister of Granaries each.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Revenue oversaw two Vice Ministers of Revenue and two Vice Ministers of Households, and one Vice Minister each of Treasury and Granaries.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書統工部、屯田侍郎各二人，虞部、水部侍郎各一人。

translations.literal: The Minister of Public Works oversaw two Vice Ministers of Public Works and two Vice Ministers of Garrison Agriculture, and one Vice Minister of Parks and one Vice Minister of Waterways each.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Public Works oversaw two Vice Ministers of Public Works and two Vice Ministers of Garrison Agriculture, and one Vice Minister each of Parks and Waterways.

sentences.zh: 凡三十六侍郎，分司曹務，直宿禁省，如漢之制。

translations.literal: In all there were thirty-six Vice Ministers, who divided the bureau affairs and stood night duty in the Forbidden Secretariat, following Han practice.
translations.idiomatic: In all there were thirty-six Vice Ministers, who divided the bureau affairs and stood night duty in the Forbidden Secretariat, following Han practice.

sentences.zh: 門下省，納言二人，給事黃門侍郎四人，錄事、通事令史各六人。

translations.literal: The Department of the Chancellery had two Remonstrators, four Supervising Secretaries of the Yellow Gate, six Recorders, and six General Clerks.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of the Chancellery had two Remonstrators, four Supervising Secretaries of the Yellow Gate, six Recorders, and six General Clerks.

sentences.zh: 又有散騎常侍、通直散騎常侍各四人，諫議大夫七人，散騎侍郎四人，員外散騎常侍六人，通直散騎侍郎四人，並掌部從朝直。

translations.literal: There were also four Regular Attendants of the Unattached Cavalry and four Regular Attendants of Direct Communication of the Unattached Cavalry, seven Remonstrating Grand Masters, four Gentlemen of the Unattached Cavalry, six Supernumerary Regular Attendants of the Unattached Cavalry, and four Gentlemen of Direct Communication of the Unattached Cavalry—all supervising attendance at court.
translations.idiomatic: There were also four Regular Attendants of the Unattached Cavalry and four Regular Attendants of Direct Communication of the Unattached Cavalry, seven Remonstrating Grand Masters, four Gentlemen of the Unattached Cavalry, six Supernumerary Regular Attendants of the Unattached Cavalry, and four Gentlemen of Direct Communication of the Unattached Cavalry—all supervising attendance at court.

sentences.zh: 又有給事二十人，員外散騎侍郎二十人，奉朝請四十人，並掌同散騎常侍等，兼出使勞問。

translations.literal: There were also twenty Supervising Secretaries, twenty Supernumerary Gentlemen of the Unattached Cavalry, and forty Gentlemen in Attendance at Court—all with the same duties as the Regular Attendants of the Unattached Cavalry and the like, and also charged with going on missions to offer condolences and inquiries.
translations.idiomatic: There were also twenty Supervising Secretaries, twenty Supernumerary Gentlemen of the Unattached Cavalry, and forty Gentlemen in Attendance at Court—all with the same duties as the Regular Attendants of the Unattached Cavalry and the like, and also charged with going on missions to offer condolences and inquiries.

sentences.zh: 統城門、尚食、尚藥、符璽、禦府、殿內等六局。

translations.literal: It oversaw the six bureaus of City Gates, Imperial Food Service, Imperial Pharmacy, Seals and Credentials, Imperial Wardrobe, and Palace Interior.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw the six bureaus of City Gates, Imperial Food Service, Imperial Pharmacy, Seals and Credentials, Imperial Wardrobe, and Palace Interior.

sentences.zh: 城門局，校尉二人，直長四人。

translations.literal: The City Gates Bureau had two Captains and four Duty Chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: The City Gates Bureau had two Captains and four Duty Chiefs.

sentences.zh: 尚食局，典禦二人，直長四人，食醫四人。

translations.literal: The Imperial Food Service Bureau had two Palace Stewards, four Duty Chiefs, and four Dietary Physicians.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Food Service Bureau had two Palace Stewards, four Duty Chiefs, and four Dietary Physicians.

sentences.zh: 尚藥局，典禦二人，侍御醫、直長各四人，醫師四十人。

translations.literal: The Imperial Pharmacy Bureau had two Palace Stewards, four Attending Physicians and four Duty Chiefs, and forty Physicians.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Pharmacy Bureau had two Palace Stewards, four Attending Physicians and four Duty Chiefs, and forty Physicians.

sentences.zh: 符璽、禦府，殿內局，監各二人，直長各四人。

translations.literal: The Seals and Credentials, Imperial Wardrobe, and Palace Interior bureaus each had two Supervisors and four Duty Chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: The Seals and Credentials, Imperial Wardrobe, and Palace Interior bureaus each had two Supervisors and four Duty Chiefs.

sentences.zh: 內史省，置監、令各一人。

translations.literal: The Department of the Palace Secretariat had one Supervisor and one Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of the Palace Secretariat had one Supervisor and one Director.

sentences.zh: 尋廢監。

translations.literal: Soon the Supervisor was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Supervisor was abolished.

sentences.zh: 置令二人，侍郎四人，舍人八人，通事舍人十六人，主書十人，錄事四人。

translations.literal: Two Directors, four Vice Directors, eight Gentlemen Attendants, sixteen Gentlemen for General Service, ten Master Scribes, and four Recorders were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Two Directors, four Vice Directors, eight Gentlemen Attendants, sixteen Gentlemen for General Service, ten Master Scribes, and four Recorders were appointed.

sentences.zh: 秘書省，監、丞各一人，郎四人，校書郎十二人，正字四人，錄事二人。

translations.literal: The Department of the Imperial Library had one Supervisor and one Assistant Director, four Gentlemen, twelve Collators, four Standardizers, and two Recorders.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of the Imperial Library had one Supervisor and one Assistant Director, four Gentlemen, twelve Collators, four Standardizers, and two Recorders.

sentences.zh: 領著作、太史二曹。

translations.literal: It oversaw the two bureaus of Compilation and Grand Astrologer.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw the two bureaus of Compilation and Grand Astrologer.

sentences.zh: 著作曹，置郎二人，佐郎八人，校書郎、正字各二人。

translations.literal: The Compilation Bureau had two Gentlemen, eight Assistant Gentlemen, and two Collators and two Standardizers each.
translations.idiomatic: The Compilation Bureau had two Gentlemen, eight Assistant Gentlemen, and two Collators and two Standardizers each.

sentences.zh: 太史曹，置令、丞各二人，司曆二人，監候四人。

translations.literal: The Grand Astrologer Bureau had two Directors and two Assistant Directors, two Calendar Officers, and four Observatory Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Astrologer Bureau had two Directors and two Assistant Directors, two Calendar Officers, and four Observatory Attendants.

sentences.zh: 其曆、天文、漏刻、視昆，各有博士及生員。

translations.literal: For calendrics, astronomy, clepsydra, and observation of the Kun star, each had its own Erudite and student personnel.
translations.idiomatic: For calendrics, astronomy, clepsydra, and observation of the Kun star, each had its own Erudite and student personnel.

sentences.zh: 內侍省，內侍、內常侍各二人，內給事四人，內謁者監六人，內寺伯二人，內謁者十二人，寺人六人，伺非八人。

translations.literal: The Department of Palace Domestic Service had two Palace Attendants and two Regular Palace Attendants, four Palace Supervising Secretaries, six Supervisors of Palace Ushers, two Palace Domestic Chiefs, twelve Palace Ushers, six Eunuch Attendants, and eight Fault Inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of Palace Domestic Service had two Palace Attendants and two Regular Palace Attendants, four Palace Supervising Secretaries, six Supervisors of Palace Ushers, two Palace Domestic Chiefs, twelve Palace Ushers, six Eunuch Attendants, and eight Fault Inspectors.

sentences.zh: 並用宦者。

translations.literal: All were eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: All were eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 領內尚食、掖庭、宮闈、奚官、內僕、內府等局。

translations.literal: It oversaw the bureaus of Inner Imperial Food Service, Palace Women, Inner Palace Gates, Servant Women, Inner Palace Servants, and Inner Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw the bureaus of Inner Imperial Food Service, Palace Women, Inner Palace Gates, Servant Women, Inner Palace Servants, and Inner Treasury.

sentences.zh: 尚食，置典禦及丞各二人。

translations.literal: The Inner Imperial Food Service had two Palace Stewards and two Assistant Directors each.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Imperial Food Service had two Palace Stewards and two Assistant Directors each.

sentences.zh: 餘各置令、丞，皆二人。

translations.literal: The rest each had two Directors and two Assistant Directors.
translations.idiomatic: The rest each had two Directors and two Assistant Directors.

sentences.zh: 其宮闈、內僕，則加置丞各一人。

translations.literal: For the Inner Palace Gates and Inner Palace Servants, one additional Assistant Director was added to each.
translations.idiomatic: For the Inner Palace Gates and Inner Palace Servants, one additional Assistant Director was added to each.

sentences.zh: 掖庭又有宮教博士二人。

translations.literal: The Palace Women Bureau also had two Erudites for Palace Instruction.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Women Bureau also had two Erudites for Palace Instruction.

sentences.zh: 御史台，大夫一人，治書侍御史二人，侍御史八人，殿內侍御史、監察御史，各十二人，錄事二人。

translations.literal: The Bureau of the Censorate had one Grand Censor, two Attending Secretaries for Legal Documents, eight Attending Censors, twelve Attending Censors for the Palace Interior and twelve Investigating Censors each, and two Recorders.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of the Censorate had one Grand Censor, two Attending Secretaries for Legal Documents, eight Attending Censors, twelve Attending Censors for the Palace Interior and twelve Investigating Censors each, and two Recorders.

sentences.zh: 後魏延昌中，王顯有寵于宣武，為御史中尉，請革選御史。

translations.literal: Later, in the Extended Splendor era of Northern Wei, Wang Xian won favor with Emperor Xuanwu and served as Censor-in-Chief; he requested reform of the selection of censors.
translations.idiomatic: Later, in the Extended Splendor era of Northern Wei, Wang Xian won favor with Emperor Xuanwu and served as Censor-in-Chief; he requested reform of the selection of censors.

sentences.zh: 此後踵其事，每一中尉，則更置御史。

translations.literal: Thereafter others followed his example; with each Censor-in-Chief, censors were newly appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter others followed his example; with each Censor-in-Chief, censors were newly appointed.

sentences.zh: 自開皇后，始自吏部選用，仍依舊入直禁中。

translations.literal: From the Kaihuang reign onward, selection began from the Ministry of Personnel, while they still entered the Forbidden Palace on duty as before.
translations.idiomatic: From the Kaihuang reign onward, selection began from the Ministry of Personnel, while they still entered the Forbidden Palace on duty as before.

sentences.zh: 都水台，使者及丞各二人，參軍三十人，河堤謁者六十人，錄事二人。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Waterways had two Commissioners and two Assistant Directors, thirty Aides-de-Camp, sixty River-Dike Attendants, and two Recorders.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterways had two Commissioners and two Assistant Directors, thirty Aides-de-Camp, sixty River-Dike Attendants, and two Recorders.

sentences.zh: 領掌船局、都水尉二人，又領諸津。

translations.literal: It supervised the Shipping Bureau and two Directors of Waterways, and also oversaw the various ferries.
translations.idiomatic: It supervised the Shipping Bureau and two Directors of Waterways, and also oversaw the various ferries.

sentences.zh: 上津每尉一人，丞二人。

translations.literal: At each major ferry there was one Captain and two Assistant Directors.
translations.idiomatic: At each major ferry there was one Captain and two Assistant Directors.

sentences.zh: 中津每尉、丞各一人。

translations.literal: At each medium ferry there was one Captain and one Assistant Director each.
translations.idiomatic: At each medium ferry there was one Captain and one Assistant Director each.

sentences.zh: 下津每典作一人，津長四人。

translations.literal: At each minor ferry there was one Ferry Manager and four Ferry Chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: At each minor ferry there was one Ferry Manager and four Ferry Chiefs.

sentences.zh: 太常、光祿、衛尉、宗正、太僕、大理、鴻臚、司農、太府等九寺，並置卿少卿各一人。

translations.literal: The nine courts of Imperial Sacrifices, Imperial Household, Guard Commandant, Imperial Clan, Imperial Stud, Judicial Review, State Ceremonial, National Granaries, and Imperial Treasury each had one Minister and one Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The nine courts of Imperial Sacrifices, Imperial Household, Guard Commandant, Imperial Clan, Imperial Stud, Judicial Review, State Ceremonial, National Granaries, and Imperial Treasury each had one Minister and one Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 太僕尋加少卿一人。

translations.literal: The Imperial Stud soon added one Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Stud soon added one Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 各置丞，太常、衛尉、宗正、大理、鴻臚、將作二人，光祿、太僕各三人，司農五人，太府六人。

translations.literal: Each had Assistant Directors: two each for Imperial Sacrifices, Guard Commandant, Imperial Clan, Judicial Review, State Ceremonial, and Palace Construction; three each for Imperial Household and Imperial Stud; five for National Granaries; and six for Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Each had Assistant Directors: two each for Imperial Sacrifices, Guard Commandant, Imperial Clan, Judicial Review, State Ceremonial, and Palace Construction; three each for Imperial Household and Imperial Stud; five for National Granaries; and six for Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 主簿，太府四人，餘寺各二人。

translations.literal: Chief Secretaries: four for Imperial Treasury, two for each of the other courts.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Secretaries: four for Imperial Treasury, two for each of the other courts.

sentences.zh: 錄事各二人。

translations.literal: Each had two Recorders.
translations.idiomatic: Each had two Recorders.

sentences.zh: 光祿則加至三人，司農、太府則各四人。

translations.literal: For Imperial Household the number was increased to three; for National Granaries and Imperial Treasury, four each.
translations.idiomatic: For Imperial Household the number was increased to three; for National Granaries and Imperial Treasury, four each.

sentences.zh: 等員。

translations.literal: And so on for the authorized posts.
translations.idiomatic: And so on for the authorized posts.

sentences.zh: 太常寺又有博士四人，協律郎二人，奉禮郎十六人。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices also had four Erudites, two Directors of Harmonizing Music, and sixteen Ceremonial Gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices also had four Erudites, two Directors of Harmonizing Music, and sixteen Ceremonial Gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 統郊社、太廟、諸陵、太祝、衣冠、太樂、清商、鼓吹、太醫、太卜、廩犧等署。

translations.literal: It oversaw the directorates of Suburban and Altar Sacrifices, Imperial Ancestral Temple, Imperial Tombs, Grand Sacrificers, Ceremonial Garments, Grand Music, Pure Music, Drum and Wind, Imperial Physicians, Grand Divination, and Sacrificial Oxen.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw the directorates of Suburban and Altar Sacrifices, Imperial Ancestral Temple, Imperial Tombs, Grand Sacrificers, Ceremonial Garments, Grand Music, Pure Music, Drum and Wind, Imperial Physicians, Grand Divination, and Sacrificial Oxen.

sentences.zh: 各置令並一人。

translations.literal: Each had one Director.
translations.idiomatic: Each had one Director.

sentences.zh: 太樂、太醫則各加至二人。

translations.literal: For Grand Music and Imperial Physicians, the number was increased to two each.
translations.idiomatic: For Grand Music and Imperial Physicians, the number was increased to two each.

sentences.zh: 丞各一人。

translations.literal: Each had one Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Each had one Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 郊社、太樂、鼓吹則各加至二人。

translations.literal: For Suburban and Altar Sacrifices, Grand Music, and Drum and Wind, the number was increased to two each.
translations.idiomatic: For Suburban and Altar Sacrifices, Grand Music, and Drum and Wind, the number was increased to two each.

sentences.zh: 郊社署又有典瑞。

translations.literal: The Suburban and Altar Sacrifices Directorate also had Palace Stewards of Auspicious Regalia.
translations.idiomatic: The Suburban and Altar Sacrifices Directorate also had Palace Stewards of Auspicious Regalia.

sentences.zh: 四人。

translations.literal: Four persons.
translations.idiomatic: Four persons.

sentences.zh: 太祝署有太祝二人。

translations.literal: The Grand Sacrificers Directorate had two Grand Sacrificers.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Sacrificers Directorate had two Grand Sacrificers.

sentences.zh: 太樂署、清商署各有樂師員。

translations.literal: The Grand Music and Pure Music directorates each had authorized Music Masters.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Music and Pure Music directorates each had authorized Music Masters.

sentences.zh: 太樂八人，清商二人。

translations.literal: Eight for Grand Music, two for Pure Music.
translations.idiomatic: Eight for Grand Music, two for Pure Music.

sentences.zh: 鼓吹署有哄師二人。

translations.literal: The Drum and Wind Directorate had two Drum Masters.
translations.idiomatic: The Drum and Wind Directorate had two Drum Masters.

sentences.zh: 太醫署有主藥、二人。

translations.literal: The Imperial Physicians Directorate had two Chief Pharmacists.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Physicians Directorate had two Chief Pharmacists.

sentences.zh: 醫師二百人。

translations.literal: Two hundred Physicians.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred Physicians.

sentences.zh: 藥園師二人。

translations.literal: Two Herb Garden Masters.
translations.idiomatic: Two Herb Garden Masters.

sentences.zh: 醫博士二人。

translations.literal: Two Medical Erudites.
translations.idiomatic: Two Medical Erudites.

sentences.zh: 助教二人。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Instructors.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Instructors.

sentences.zh: 按摩博士二人。

translations.literal: Two Massage Erudites.
translations.idiomatic: Two Massage Erudites.

sentences.zh: 祝禁博士二人。

translations.literal: Two Incantation Erudites.
translations.idiomatic: Two Incantation Erudites.

translations.idiomatic: Each mobile office had one Supervisor and one Deputy Supervisor each for Food and Goods, Agriculture and Gardens, Weapons, and Crafts.

sentences.zh: 各置丞、食貨四人，農圃六人，武器二人，百工四人。

translations.idiomatic: Assistant Directors numbered four for Food and Goods, six for Agriculture and Gardens, two for Weapons, and four for Crafts.

sentences.zh: 開皇初，置詹事。

translations.idiomatic: It oversaw the six bureaus of Classics Administration, Palace Gates, Inner Attendance, Palace Provisions, Medicine Storage, and Fast Observance.

translations.idiomatic: The Classics Administration had four Study Companions, six Collators, and two Standardizers.

translations.idiomatic: The Palace Gates Bureau had two Grand Masters.

sentences.zh: 內直置監、副監各二人，監殿舍人四人。

translations.literal: The Inner Attendance Bureau had two Supervisors and two Deputy Supervisors, and four Gentlemen Attendants of the Palace Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Attendance Bureau had two Supervisors and two Deputy Supervisors, and four Gentlemen Attendants of the Palace Hall.

translations.idiomatic: Below the sixth rank there were also forty-three designations of generals such as Assisting Army, in all sixteen ranks of honorary general titles, used for broad conferral.

translations.idiomatic: Those in bureau posts with duties were executive officials; those without duties were honorary officials.

translations.idiomatic: Military ranks from Supreme Pillar of State downward were honorary substantive ranks; army titles were honorary designation ranks.

translations.idiomatic: It managed four Supervisors for east, south, west, and north, each also with a Deputy Supervisor and Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 隴右牧，置總監、副監、丞，以統諸牧。

translations.literal: For Longyou Pasture, a Grand Supervisor, Deputy Supervisor, and Assistant Director were appointed to oversee all pastures.
translations.idiomatic: For Longyou Pasture, a Grand Supervisor, Deputy Supervisor, and Assistant Director were appointed to oversee all pastures.

sentences.zh: 其驊騮牧及二十四軍馬牧，每牧置儀同及尉、大都督、帥都督等員。

translations.literal: For the Piebald Horse Pasture and the twenty-four army horse pastures, each pasture had Third Rank Equal Companion, Commandant, Great Area Commander, and Commandant Commander posts.
translations.idiomatic: For the Piebald Horse Pasture and the twenty-four army horse pastures, each pasture had Third Rank Equal Companion, Commandant, Great Area Commander, and Commandant Commander posts.

sentences.zh: 驢騾牧，置帥都督及尉。

translations.literal: For the Donkey and Mule Pasture, Commandant Commander and Commandant were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: For the Donkey and Mule Pasture, Commandant Commander and Commandant were appointed.

sentences.zh: 原州羊牧，置大都督並尉。

translations.literal: For the Yuanzhou Sheep Pasture, a Great Area Commander and Commandant were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: For the Yuanzhou Sheep Pasture, a Great Area Commander and Commandant were appointed.

sentences.zh: 原州駝牛牧，置尉。

translations.literal: For the Yuanzhou Camel and Ox Pasture, a Commandant was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: For the Yuanzhou Camel and Ox Pasture, a Commandant was appointed.

sentences.zh: 又有皮毛監、副監及丞、錄事。

translations.literal: There were also Fur and Hide Supervisor, Deputy Supervisor, Assistant Director, and Recorder.
translations.idiomatic: There were also Fur and Hide Supervisor, Deputy Supervisor, Assistant Director, and Recorder.

sentences.zh: 又鹽州牧監，置監及副監，置丞，統諸羊牧，牧置尉。

translations.literal: Also for Yanchzhou Pasture Supervisor, a Supervisor and Deputy Supervisor were appointed, with an Assistant Director, overseeing all sheep pastures, each pasture with a Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Also for Yanchzhou Pasture Supervisor, a Supervisor and Deputy Supervisor were appointed, with an Assistant Director, overseeing all sheep pastures, each pasture with a Commandant.

sentences.zh: 苑川十二馬牧，每牧置大都督及尉各一人，帥都督二人。

translations.literal: For the Yuanchuan twelve horse pastures, each pasture had one Great Area Commander and one Commandant, and two Commandant Commanders.
translations.idiomatic: For the Yuanchuan twelve horse pastures, each pasture had one Great Area Commander and one Commandant, and two Commandant Commanders.

sentences.zh: 沙苑羊牧，置尉二人。

translations.literal: For the Shayuan Sheep Pasture, two Commandants were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: For the Shayuan Sheep Pasture, two Commandants were appointed.

sentences.zh: 緣邊交市監及諸屯監，每監置監、副監各一人。

translations.literal: For frontier trade Supervisors and garrison Supervisors, each Supervisor had one Supervisor and one Deputy Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: For frontier trade Supervisors and garrison Supervisors, each Supervisor had one Supervisor and one Deputy Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 畿內者隸司農，自外隸諸州焉。

translations.literal: Those within the capital region were subordinate to the Court of National Granaries; all others were subordinate to the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Those within the capital region were subordinate to the Court of National Granaries; all others were subordinate to the various prefectures.

sentences.zh: 五嶽各置令，又有吳山令，以供其灑掃。

translations.literal: Each of the Five Sacred Mountains had a Magistrate, and there was also a Wushan Magistrate to supply sweeping and cleaning.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the Five Sacred Mountains had a Magistrate, and there was also a Wushan Magistrate to supply sweeping and cleaning.

sentences.zh: 三師、王、三公，為正一品。

translations.literal: The Three Preceptors, Princes, and Three Dukes were Regular First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Preceptors, Princes, and Three Dukes were Regular First Rank.

sentences.zh: 上柱國、郡王、國公、開國郡縣公，為從一品。

translations.literal: Supreme Pillar of State, Prince of a Commandery, Duke of a State, Duke of a Commandery, and Duke of a County were Secondary First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Pillar of State, Prince of a Commandery, Duke of a State, Duke of a Commandery, and Duke of a County were Secondary First Rank.

sentences.zh: 柱國、太子三師、特進、尚書令、左右光祿大夫、開國侯，為正二品。

translations.literal: Pillar of State, Crown Prince Three Preceptors, Special Advancement, Director of the Secretariat, Left and Right Grand Masters of Splendid Happiness, and Enfeoffed Marquis were Regular Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar of State, Crown Prince Three Preceptors, Special Advancement, Director of the Secretariat, Left and Right Grand Masters of Splendid Happiness, and Enfeoffed Marquis were Regular Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 上大將軍、尚書左右僕射、雍州牧、金紫光祿大夫，為從二品。

translations.literal: Grand General-in-Chief, Left and Right Vice Directors of the Secretariat, Governor of Yong Province, and Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon were Secondary Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General-in-Chief, Left and Right Vice Directors of the Secretariat, Governor of Yong Province, and Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon were Secondary Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 大將軍，吏部尚書，太常、光祿、衛尉等三卿，太子三少，納言，內史令，左右衛、左右武衛、左右武候、領左右等大將軍，禮部、兵部、都官、度支、工部尚書，宗正、太僕、大理、鴻臚、司農、太府等六卿，上州刺史，京兆尹，秘書監，銀青光祿大夫，開國伯，為正三品。

translations.literal: General-in-Chief, Minister of Personnel, Ministers of Imperial Sacrifices, Imperial Household, and Guard Commandant, Crown Prince Three Junior Preceptors, Remonstrator, Director of the Palace Secretariat, Grand Generals of the Left and Right Guards, Martial Guards, Martial Patrol, and Command, Ministers of Rites, War, Justice, Revenue, and Public Works, Ministers of Imperial Clan, Imperial Stud, Judicial Review, State Ceremonial, National Granaries, and Imperial Treasury, Regional Inspector of an upper prefecture, Prefect of Jingzhao, Supervisor of the Imperial Library, Grand Master of the Silver Seal and Blue Ribbon, and Enfeoffed Earl were Regular Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: General-in-Chief, Minister of Personnel, Ministers of Imperial Sacrifices, Imperial Household, and Guard Commandant, Crown Prince Three Junior Preceptors, Remonstrator, Director of the Palace Secretariat, Grand Generals of the Left and Right Guards, Martial Guards, Martial Patrol, and Command, Ministers of Rites, War, Justice, Revenue, and Public Works, Ministers of Imperial Clan, Imperial Stud, Judicial Review, State Ceremonial, National Granaries, and Imperial Treasury, Regional Inspector of an upper prefecture, Prefect of Jingzhao, Supervisor of the Imperial Library, Grand Master of the Silver Seal and Blue Ribbon, and Enfeoffed Earl were Regular Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 上開府儀同三司，散騎常侍，左右衛、武衛、武候、領左右、監門等將軍，國子祭酒，御史大夫，將作大匠，中州刺史，親王師，朝議大夫，為從三品。

translations.literal: Grand Opener of the Office with Third Rank Equal Companionship, Regular Attendant of the Unattached Cavalry, Generals of the Left and Right Guards, Martial Guards, Martial Patrol, Command, and Gate Guards, Libationer of the Directorate of Education, Grand Censor, Master Builder, Regional Inspector of a middle prefecture, and Prince's Tutor were Secondary Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Opener of the Office with Third Rank Equal Companionship, Regular Attendant of the Unattached Cavalry, Generals of the Left and Right Guards, Martial Guards, Martial Patrol, Command, and Gate Guards, Libationer of the Directorate of Education, Grand Censor, Master Builder, Regional Inspector of a middle prefecture, and Prince's Tutor were Secondary Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 驃騎將軍，開府儀同三司，太常、光祿、衛尉等三少卿，太子左右衛、宗衛、內等率，尚書吏部侍郎，給事黃門侍郎，太子左庶子，宗正、太僕、大理、鴻臚、司農、太府等少卿，下州刺史，已前上階。

translations.literal: General of Fast Cavalry, Opener of the Office with Third Rank Equal Companionship, three Vice Ministers of Imperial Sacrifices, Imperial Household, and Guard Commandant, Commandants of the Crown Prince's Left and Right Guards, Imperial Clan Guards, and Inner Command, Vice Minister of Personnel, Supervising Secretary of the Yellow Gate, Left Subordinate of the Heir Apparent, Vice Ministers of Imperial Clan, Imperial Stud, Judicial Review, State Ceremonial, National Granaries, and Imperial Treasury, Regional Inspector of a lower prefecture—all preceding upper sub-ranks.
translations.idiomatic: General of Fast Cavalry, Opener of the Office with Third Rank Equal Companionship, three Vice Ministers of Imperial Sacrifices, Imperial Household, and Guard Commandant, Commandants of the Crown Prince's Left and Right Guards, Imperial Clan Guards, and Inner Command, Vice Minister of Personnel, Supervising Secretary of the Yellow Gate, Left Subordinate of the Heir Apparent, Vice Ministers of Imperial Clan, Imperial Stud, Judicial Review, State Ceremonial, National Granaries, and Imperial Treasury, Regional Inspector of a lower prefecture—all preceding upper sub-ranks.

sentences.zh: 內史侍郎，太子右庶子，通直散騎常侍，左右監門郎將，朝散大夫，開國子，為正四品。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Palace Secretariat, Right Subordinate of the Heir Apparent, Regular Attendant of Direct Communication of the Unattached Cavalry, Commandant of the Left and Right Gate Guards, Grand Master for Court Dispersal, and Enfeoffed Viscount were Regular Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Palace Secretariat, Right Subordinate of the Heir Apparent, Regular Attendant of Direct Communication of the Unattached Cavalry, Commandant of the Left and Right Gate Guards, Grand Master for Court Dispersal, and Enfeoffed Viscount were Regular Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 上儀同三司，尚書左丞，太子左右衛、宗衛、內等副率，左右監門率，上郡太守，雍州別駕，親王府長史，太子家令，率更令、僕，內侍，城門校尉，已前上階。

translations.literal: Grand Third Rank Equal Companion, Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat, Deputy Commandants of the Crown Prince's Left and Right Guards, Imperial Clan Guards, and Inner Command, Commandants of the Left and Right Gate Guards, Grand Administrator of an upper commandery, Administrative Aide of Yong Province, Chief Administrator of a princely estate, Steward of the Crown Prince, Commandant of Watch, Chamberlain, Palace Attendant, Captain of the City Gates—all preceding upper sub-ranks.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞，上鎮將軍，雍州贊務，直闔將軍，親王府司馬，諫議大夫，為從四品。

translations.literal: Right Assistant Director of the Secretariat, Commander of an upper garrison, Assistant Administrator of Yong Province, Direct-Pavilion General, Administrator of a princely estate, and Remonstrating Grand Master were Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Right Assistant Director of the Secretariat, Commander of an upper garrison, Assistant Administrator of Yong Province, Direct-Pavilion General, Administrator of a princely estate, and Remonstrating Grand Master were Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 車騎將軍，儀同三司，內常侍，秘書丞，國子博士，散騎侍郎，太子內舍人，太子左右監門副率，員外散騎常侍，上州長史，親王府諮議參軍事，開國男，已前上階。

translations.literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry, Third Rank Equal Companion, Regular Palace Attendant, Assistant Director of the Imperial Library, Erudite of the Directorate of Education, Gentleman of the Unattached Cavalry, Inner Gentlemen Attendant of the Crown Prince, Deputy Commandants of the Crown Prince's Left and Right Gate Guards, Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Unattached Cavalry, Chief Administrator of an upper prefecture, Advisory Aide-de-Camp of a princely estate, and Enfeoffed Baron—all preceding upper sub-ranks.
translations.idiomatic: General of Chariots and Cavalry, Third Rank Equal Companion, Regular Palace Attendant, Assistant Director of the Imperial Library, Erudite of the Directorate of Education, Gentleman of the Unattached Cavalry, Inner Gentlemen Attendant of the Crown Prince, Deputy Commandants of the Crown Prince's Left and Right Gate Guards, Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Unattached Cavalry, Chief Administrator of an upper prefecture, Advisory Aide-de-Camp of a princely estate, and Enfeoffed Baron—all preceding upper sub-ranks.

sentences.zh: 尚食、尚藥典禦，上州司馬，為正五品。

translations.literal: Palace Stewards of Imperial Food Service and Imperial Pharmacy, and Administrator of an upper prefecture were Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Stewards of Imperial Food Service and Imperial Pharmacy, and Administrator of an upper prefecture were Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 著作郎，通直散騎侍郎，中郡太守，直寢，太子洗馬，中州長史，奉車都尉，已前上階。

translations.literal: Gentleman of Compilation, Regular Attendant of Direct Communication of the Unattached Cavalry, Grand Administrator of a middle commandery, Direct-Quarters Officer, Study Companion of the Crown Prince, Chief Administrator of a middle prefecture, Commandant of Chariots in Attendance—all preceding upper sub-ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman of Compilation, Regular Attendant of Direct Communication of the Unattached Cavalry, Grand Administrator of a middle commandery, Direct-Quarters Officer, Study Companion of the Crown Prince, Chief Administrator of a middle prefecture, Commandant of Chariots in Attendance—all preceding upper sub-ranks.

sentences.zh: 都水使者，治書侍御史，大興、長安令，大理司直，直齋，太子直閤，京兆郡丞，中州司馬，中鎮將，上鎮副，內給事，駙馬都尉，親王友，員外散騎侍郎，為從五品。

translations.literal: Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways, Attending Secretary for Legal Documents, Magistrates of Daxing and Chang'an, Direct Investigator of Judicial Review, Direct-Fast Officer, Direct-Pavilion Officer of the Crown Prince, Assistant Director of Jingzhao Commandery, Administrator of a middle prefecture, Commander of a middle garrison, Deputy Commander of an upper garrison, Palace Supervising Secretary, Commandant of the Horse Guard, Friend of a Prince, Supernumerary Gentleman of the Unattached Cavalry were Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner of the Directorate of Waterways, Attending Secretary for Legal Documents, Magistrates of Daxing and Chang'an, Direct Investigator of Judicial Review, Direct-Fast Officer, Direct-Pavilion Officer of the Crown Prince, Assistant Director of Jingzhao Commandery, Administrator of a middle prefecture, Commander of a middle garrison, Deputy Commander of an upper garrison, Palace Supervising Secretary, Commandant of the Horse Guard, Friend of a Prince, Supernumerary Gentleman of the Unattached Cavalry were Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 翊軍、翊師將軍，尚書諸曹侍郎，內史舍人，下郡太守，大都督，親王府掾屬，下州長史，已前上階。

translations.literal: Assisting Army and Assisting Master Generals, Vice Ministers of the various bureaus of the Secretariat, Gentlemen Attendant of the Palace Secretariat, Grand Administrator of a lower commandery, Great Area Commander, Assistant of a princely estate, Chief Administrator of a lower prefecture—all preceding upper sub-ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Assisting Army and Assisting Master Generals, Vice Ministers of the various bureaus of the Secretariat, Gentlemen Attendant of the Palace Secretariat, Grand Administrator of a lower commandery, Great Area Commander, Assistant of a princely estate, Chief Administrator of a lower prefecture—all preceding upper sub-ranks.

sentences.zh: 四征將軍，征東、征南、征西、征北。

translations.literal: The Four Expeditionary Generals: Expeditionary East, South, West, and North.
translations.idiomatic: They comprised the Four Expeditionary Generals: East, South, West, and North.

sentences.zh: 三將軍，內軍、鎮軍、撫軍。

translations.literal: The Three Generals: Inner Army, Garrison Army, and Pacification Army.
translations.idiomatic: They comprised the Three Generals: Inner Army, Garrison Army, and Pacification Army.

sentences.zh: 大理正、監、評、千牛備身左右，左右監門校尉，內尚食典禦，符璽監，禦府監，殿內監，太子內直監，下州司馬，下鎮將，中鎮副，為正六品。

translations.literal: Director, Supervisor, and Evaluator of Judicial Review, Left and Right Bodyguards, Captains of the Left and Right Gate Guards, Inner Imperial Food Service Palace Steward, Supervisors of Seals and Credentials, Imperial Wardrobe, and Palace Interior, Inner Attendance Supervisor of the Crown Prince, Administrator of a lower prefecture, Commander of a lower garrison, Deputy Commander of a middle garrison were Regular Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Director, Supervisor, and Evaluator of Judicial Review, Left and Right Bodyguards, Captains of the Left and Right Gate Guards, Inner Imperial Food Service Palace Steward, Supervisors of Seals and Credentials, Imperial Wardrobe, and Palace Interior, Inner Attendance Supervisor of the Crown Prince, Administrator of a lower prefecture, Commander of a lower garrison, Deputy Commander of a middle garrison were Regular Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 四平將軍，平東、平南、平西、平北。

translations.literal: The Four Pacification Generals: Pacification East, South, West, and North.
translations.idiomatic: They comprised the Four Pacification Generals: East, South, West, and North.

sentences.zh: 四將軍，前軍、後軍、左軍、右軍。

translations.literal: The Four Generals: Front Army, Rear Army, Left Army, and Right Army.
translations.idiomatic: They comprised the Four Generals: Front, Rear, Left, and Right Armies.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人，親王文學，帥都督，左右領軍府長史，太子直寢，親王府主簿，親王府錄事參軍事，太子門大夫，給事，上縣令，已前上階。

translations.literal: Gentleman for General Service, Literary Scholar of a Prince, Commandant Commander, Chief Clerk of the Left and Right Army Command, Direct-Quarters Officer of the Crown Prince, Chief Secretary of a princely estate, Recorder Aide-de-Camp of a princely estate, Grand Master of the Palace Gates of the Crown Prince, Supervising Secretary, Magistrate of an upper county—all preceding upper sub-ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman for General Service, Literary Scholar of a Prince, Commandant Commander, Chief Clerk of the Left and Right Army Command, Direct-Quarters Officer of the Crown Prince, Chief Secretary of a princely estate, Recorder Aide-de-Camp of a princely estate, Grand Master of the Palace Gates of the Crown Prince, Supervising Secretary, Magistrate of an upper county—all preceding upper sub-ranks.

sentences.zh: 冠軍、輔國二將軍，太子舍人，直後，三寺丞，親王府功曹、記室、倉戶曹參軍事，城門直長，太子直齋，太子副直監，太子典內，左右領軍府司馬，下鎮副，為從六品。

translations.literal: Champion and Assisting State Generals, Gentlemen Attendant of the Crown Prince, Direct-Rear Officer, Assistant Directors of the three courts, Merit Officer and Secretariat and Granary and Household Aides-de-Camp of a princely estate, Duty Chief of the City Gates, Direct-Fast Officer of the Crown Prince, Deputy Direct Supervisor of the Crown Prince, Inner Ward Chief of the Crown Prince, Marshal of the Left and Right Army Command, Deputy Commander of a lower garrison were Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Champion and Assisting State Generals, Gentlemen Attendant of the Crown Prince, Direct-Rear Officer, Assistant Directors of the three courts, Merit Officer and Secretariat and Granary and Household Aides-de-Camp of a princely estate, Duty Chief of the City Gates, Direct-Fast Officer of the Crown Prince, Deputy Direct Supervisor of the Crown Prince, Inner Ward Chief of the Crown Prince, Marshal of the Left and Right Army Command, Deputy Commander of a lower garrison were Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 鎮遠、安遠二將軍，員外散騎侍郎，御醫，左右衛、武衛、武候、領左右等府長史，親衛，親王府諸曹參軍事，已前上階。

translations.literal: Far Garrison and Pacifying Distance Generals, Supernumerary Gentleman of the Unattached Cavalry, Attending Physician, Chief Clerks of the Left and Right Guards, Martial Guards, Martial Patrol, and Command offices, Personal Guard, various bureau Aides-de-Camp of a princely estate—all preceding upper sub-ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Far Garrison and Pacifying Distance Generals, Supernumerary Gentleman of the Unattached Cavalry, Attending Physician, Chief Clerks of the Left and Right Guards, Martial Guards, Martial Patrol, and Command offices, Personal Guard, various bureau Aides-de-Camp of a princely estate—all preceding upper sub-ranks.

sentences.zh: 建威、甯朔二將軍，六寺丞，秘書郎，著作佐郎，太子千牛備身，太子備身左右，尚食、尚藥、左右監門等直長，太子通事舍人，左右衛、武衛、武候、領左右等府司馬，都督，太子典膳、藥藏等監，太子齋帥，上戍主，為正七品。

translations.literal: Establishing Might and Pacifying North Generals, Assistant Directors of the six courts, Gentleman of the Imperial Library, Assistant Gentleman of Compilation, Thousand-Ox Bodyguard of the Crown Prince, Left and Right Bodyguard of the Crown Prince, Duty Chiefs of Imperial Food Service, Imperial Pharmacy, and Left and Right Gate Guards, Gentlemen for General Service of the Crown Prince, Marshals of the Left and Right Guards, Martial Guards, Martial Patrol, and Command offices, Commander, Supervisors of Palace Provisions and Medicine Storage of the Crown Prince, Fast Observance Officer of the Crown Prince, Chief of an upper frontier post were Regular Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 甯遠、振威二將軍，左右監門府長史，太子左右衛、宗衛等率，左右虞侯、左右內率等府長史，符璽、禦府、殿內等直長，上州錄事參軍事，左右領軍府掾屬，親王府東西閣祭酒，中縣令，上郡丞，太子親衛，將作丞，勳衛，親王府參軍事，上鎮長史，已前上階。

translations.literal: Pacifying Distance and Shaking Might Generals, Chief Clerks of the Left and Right Gate Guard offices, Commandants of the Crown Prince's Left and Right Guards and Imperial Clan Guards, Chief Clerks of the Left and Right Patrol Guard and Inner Commandant offices, Duty Chiefs of Seals and Credentials, Imperial Wardrobe, and Palace Interior, Recorder Aide-de-Camp of an upper prefecture, Clerks and Assistants of the Left and Right Army Command, Libationers of the Eastern and Western Pavilions of a princely estate, Magistrate of a middle county, Assistant Director of an upper commandery, Personal Guard of the Crown Prince, Assistant Director of Palace Construction, Meritorious Guard, Aide-de-Camp of a princely estate, Chief Administrator of an upper garrison—all preceding upper sub-ranks.

translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerk and Marshal of the offices of Grand Third Rank Equal Companion and Third Rank Equal Companion, various bureau Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand General-in-Chief and General-in-Chief, Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Supreme Pillar of State, Heir Prince, Prince of a Commandery, and Pillar of State, Acting Aides-de-Camp, Supervisors of a Mobile Office, Supervisors of Tong Province, four Supervisors of Salt Pools, Fur and Hide Supervisor, Supervisor of Qi Province, Assistant Directors of the Supervisors of Tong Province and Longyou Pasture, Supervisors of major smelting works, Chief Secretary of the Provincial Chief of Yong Province, State Director of Viscount and Baron, Grand Agriculture Commandant and Palace Guard Officer of Marquis and Earl, and Regular Attendant of the state of Princes and Consorts of the Two Kings held Honorary Regular Eighth Rank.

sentences.zh: 行台尚書都事，上開府、開府府諸曹參軍事，上大將軍、大將軍府參軍事、諸曹行參軍，上柱國、嗣王、郡王、柱國府行參軍，五嶽、四瀆、吳山等令，鹽池四面副監，諸皮毛副監，行台諸副監，諸屯副監，諸中冶監，諸緣邊交市監，鹽池總監丞，諸州州都主簿，雍州西曹書佐、諸曹從事，京兆郡正功曹，太學生，子、男國大農、典衛，為視從八品。

translations.literal: Chief Clerk of the Secretariat of a Mobile Office, various bureau Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand Opener of the Office and Opener of the Office, Aides-de-Camp and Acting Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand General-in-Chief and General-in-Chief, Acting Aides-de-Camp and Registry Clerks of the offices of Supreme Pillar of State, Heir Prince, Prince of a Commandery, and Pillar of State, Magistrates of the Five Sacred Mountains, Four Rivers, and Wushan, Deputy Supervisors of the four sides of Salt Pools, various Fur and Hide Deputy Supervisors, Deputy Supervisors of a Mobile Office, Garrison Deputy Supervisors, Supervisors of medium smelting works, Frontier Trade Supervisors, Assistant Director of the Salt Pool Grand Supervisor, Chief Secretaries of the Provincial Chiefs of the various prefectures, Western Bureau Secretary and various bureau Aides of Yong Province, Chief Merit Officer of Jingzhao Commandery, students of Grand Learning, Grand Agriculture Officer and Palace Guard Officer of Viscount and Baron were Honorary Secondary Eighth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerk of the Secretariat of a Mobile Office, various bureau Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand Opener of the Office and Opener of the Office, Aides-de-Camp and Acting Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand General-in-Chief and General-in-Chief, Acting Aides-de-Camp and Registry Clerks of the offices of Supreme Pillar of State, Heir Prince, Prince of a Commandery, and Pillar of State, Magistrates of the Five Sacred Mountains, Four Rivers, and Wushan, Deputy Supervisors of the four sides of Salt Pools, various Fur and Hide Deputy Supervisors, Deputy Supervisors of a Mobile Office, Garrison Deputy Supervisors, Supervisors of medium smelting works, Frontier Trade Supervisors, Assistant Director of the Salt Pool Grand Supervisor, Chief Secretaries of the Provincial Chiefs of the various prefectures, Western Bureau Secretary and various bureau Aides of Yong Province, Chief Merit Officer of Jingzhao Commandery, students of Grand Learning, Grand Agriculture Officer and Palace Guard Officer of Viscount and Baron held Honorary Secondary Eighth Rank.

sentences.zh: 開府府法曹行參軍，上儀同、儀同府諸曹參軍事，上大將軍、大將軍府行參軍，上柱國、嗣王、郡王、柱國府典簽，同州諸副監，岐州副監，諸小冶監，鹽州牧監丞，諸大冶監丞，諸緣邊交市副監，諸郡正、功曹，京兆郡主簿，諸州西曹書佐、祭酒從事，雍州部郡從事，公國常侍，王、二王后國侍郎，公主家令，諸州胡二百戶已上薩保，為視正九品。

translations.literal: Law Bureau Acting Aide-de-Camp of the Opener of the Office, various bureau Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand Third Rank Equal Companion and Third Rank Equal Companion, Acting Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand General-in-Chief and General-in-Chief, Registry Clerks of the offices of Supreme Pillar of State, Heir Prince, Prince of a Commandery, and Pillar of State, Deputy Supervisors of Tong Province, Deputy Supervisor of Qi Province, Supervisors of minor smelting works, Assistant Director of the Yanchzhou Pasture Supervisor, Assistant Directors of major smelting works, Deputy Supervisors of Frontier Trade, Commandery Chiefs and Merit Officers, Chief Secretary of Jingzhao Commandery, Western Bureau Secretaries and Libationer Aides of the various prefectures, Department Commandery Aide of Yong Province, Regular Attendant of a Duke's state, Vice Minister of the state of Princes and Consorts of the Two Kings, Steward of a Princess, and Sabaobao of various prefectures with more than two hundred Hu households were Honorary Regular Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Law Bureau Acting Aide-de-Camp of the Opener of the Office, various bureau Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand Third Rank Equal Companion and Third Rank Equal Companion, Acting Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand General-in-Chief and General-in-Chief, Registry Clerks of the offices of Supreme Pillar of State, Heir Prince, Prince of a Commandery, and Pillar of State, Deputy Supervisors of Tong Province, Deputy Supervisor of Qi Province, Supervisors of minor smelting works, Assistant Director of the Yanchzhou Pasture Supervisor, Assistant Directors of major smelting works, Deputy Supervisors of Frontier Trade, Commandery Chiefs and Merit Officers, Chief Secretary of Jingzhao Commandery, Western Bureau Secretaries and Libationer Aides of the various prefectures, Department Commandery Aide of Yong Province, Regular Attendant of a Duke's state, Vice Minister of the state of Princes and Consorts of the Two Kings, Steward of a Princess, and Sabaobao of various prefectures with more than two hundred Hu households held Honorary Regular Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 儀同府法曹行參軍，上開府、開府府行參軍，上大將軍、大將軍府典簽，上儀同、儀同府行參軍，上開府府典簽，行台諸監丞，鹽池四面監丞，皮毛監丞，諸中冶監丞，四門學生，諸郡主簿，諸州部郡從事，雍州武猛從事，大興、長安縣正、功曹、主簿，侯、伯、子、男國常侍，公國侍郎，為視從九品。

translations.literal: Law Bureau Acting Aide-de-Camp of the Third Rank Equal Companion office, Acting Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand Opener of the Office and Opener of the Office, Registry Clerks of the offices of Grand General-in-Chief and General-in-Chief, Acting Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand Third Rank Equal Companion and Third Rank Equal Companion, Registry Clerks of the Grand Opener of the Office, Assistant Directors of the Supervisors of a Mobile Office, Assistant Directors of the four Supervisors of Salt Pools, Assistant Director of the Fur and Hide Supervisor, Assistant Directors of medium smelting works, students of the Four Gates, Chief Secretaries of the various commanderies, Department Commandery Aides of the various prefectures, Martial Aide of Yong Province, Chiefs, Merit Officers, and Chief Secretaries of Daxing and Chang'an, Regular Attendants of the states of Marquis, Earl, Viscount, and Baron, and Vice Ministers of a Duke's state were Honorary Secondary Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Law Bureau Acting Aide-de-Camp of the Third Rank Equal Companion office, Acting Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand Opener of the Office and Opener of the Office, Registry Clerks of the offices of Grand General-in-Chief and General-in-Chief, Acting Aides-de-Camp of the offices of Grand Third Rank Equal Companion and Third Rank Equal Companion, Registry Clerks of the Grand Opener of the Office, Assistant Directors of the Supervisors of a Mobile Office, Assistant Directors of the four Supervisors of Salt Pools, Assistant Director of the Fur and Hide Supervisor, Assistant Directors of medium smelting works, students of the Four Gates, Chief Secretaries of the various commanderies, Department Commandery Aides of the various prefectures, Martial Aide of Yong Province, Chiefs, Merit Officers, and Chief Secretaries of Daxing and Chang'an, Regular Attendants of the states of Marquis, Earl, Viscount, and Baron, and Vice Ministers of a Duke's state held Honorary Secondary Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 又有流外勳品、二品、三品、四品、五品、六品、七品、八品、九品之差。

translations.literal: There were also differences among outside-the-register merit ranks of second through ninth grades.
translations.idiomatic: There were also differences among outside-the-register merit ranks of second through ninth grades.

sentences.zh: 又視流外，亦有視勳品、視二品、視三品、視四品、視五品、視六品、視七品、視八品、視九品之差。

translations.literal: Among outside-the-register honorary ranks, there were also differences among honorary merit rank and honorary second through ninth grades.
translations.idiomatic: Among outside-the-register honorary ranks, there were also differences among honorary merit rank and honorary second through ninth grades.

sentences.zh: 極於胥吏矣，皆無上下階雲。

translations.literal: This extended down to clerks, and none had upper or lower sub-ranks.
translations.idiomatic: This extended down to clerks, and none had upper or lower sub-ranks.

sentences.zh: 京官正一品，祿九百石，其下每以百石為差，至正四品，是為三百石。

translations.literal: For capital officials of Regular First Rank, salary was nine hundred shi; below that, each rank differed by one hundred shi, down to Regular Fourth Rank at three hundred shi.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials of Regular First Rank received nine hundred shi in salary; below that, each rank differed by one hundred shi, down to Regular Fourth Rank at three hundred shi.

sentences.zh: 從四品，二百五十石，其下每以五十石為差，至正六品，是為百石。

translations.literal: Secondary Fourth Rank received two hundred fifty shi; below that, each rank differed by fifty shi, down to Regular Sixth Rank at one hundred shi.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary Fourth Rank received two hundred fifty shi; below that, each rank differed by fifty shi, down to Regular Sixth Rank at one hundred shi.

sentences.zh: 從六品，九十石，以下每以十石為差，至從八品，是為五十石。

translations.literal: Secondary Sixth Rank received ninety shi; below that, each rank differed by ten shi, down to Secondary Eighth Rank at fifty shi.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary Sixth Rank received ninety shi; below that, each rank differed by ten shi, down to Secondary Eighth Rank at fifty shi.

sentences.zh: 食封及官不判事者，並九品，皆不給祿。

translations.literal: Those with enfeoffment income and officials who did not decide cases were all ninth rank and received no salary.
translations.idiomatic: Those with enfeoffment income and officials who did not decide cases were all ninth rank and received no salary.

sentences.zh: 其給皆以春秋二季。

translations.literal: Payment was made in the spring and autumn seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Payment was made in the spring and autumn seasons.

sentences.zh: 刺史、太守、縣令，則計戶而給祿，各以戶數為九等之差。

translations.literal: For Regional Inspectors, Grand Administrators, and Magistrates, salary was calculated by households, with nine grades of difference according to household count.
translations.idiomatic: For Regional Inspectors, Grand Administrators, and Magistrates, salary was calculated by households, with nine grades of difference according to household count.

sentences.zh: 大州六百二十石，其下每以四十石為差，至於下下，則三百石。

translations.literal: A large prefecture received six hundred twenty shi; below that, each grade differed by forty shi, down to the lowest grade at three hundred shi.
translations.idiomatic: A large prefecture received six hundred twenty shi; below that, each grade differed by forty shi, down to the lowest grade at three hundred shi.

sentences.zh: 大郡三百四十石，其下每以三十石為差，至於下下，則百石。

translations.literal: A large commandery received three hundred forty shi; below that, each grade differed by thirty shi, down to the lowest grade at one hundred shi.
translations.idiomatic: A large commandery received three hundred forty shi; below that, each grade differed by thirty shi, down to the lowest grade at one hundred shi.

sentences.zh: 大縣百四十石，其下每以十石為差，至於下下，則六十石。

translations.literal: A large county received one hundred forty shi; below that, each grade differed by ten shi, down to the lowest grade at sixty shi.
translations.idiomatic: A large county received one hundred forty shi; below that, each grade differed by ten shi, down to the lowest grade at sixty shi.

sentences.zh: 其祿唯及刺史二佐及郡守、縣令。

translations.literal: Salary applied only to Regional Inspectors, their two aides, Grand Administrators, and Magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: Salary applied only to Regional Inspectors, their two aides, Grand Administrators, and Magistrates.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，詔尚書左僕射，掌判吏部、禮部、兵部三尚書事，御史糾不當者，兼糾彈之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year, an edict ordered the Left Vice Director of the Secretariat to oversee and decide the affairs of the three Ministers of Personnel, Rites, and War; the Censorate would impeach improper conduct and also conduct impeachment and investigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year, an edict ordered the Left Vice Director of the Secretariat to oversee and decide the affairs of the three Ministers of Personnel, Rites, and War; the Censorate would impeach improper conduct and also conduct impeachment and investigation.

sentences.zh: 尚書右僕射，掌判都官、度支、工部三尚書事，又知用度。

translations.literal: The Right Vice Director of the Secretariat oversaw and decided the affairs of the three Ministers of Justice, Revenue, and Public Works, and also managed expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Vice Director of the Secretariat oversaw and decided the affairs of the three Ministers of Justice, Revenue, and Public Works, and also managed expenditures.

sentences.zh: 餘皆依舊。

translations.literal: All else followed the old practice.
translations.idiomatic: All else followed the old practice.

sentences.zh: 尋改度支尚書為戶部尚書，都官尚書為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Soon the Minister of Revenue was renamed Minister of Households, and the Minister of Justice was renamed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Minister of Revenue was renamed Minister of Households, and the Minister of Justice was renamed Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 諸曹侍郎及內史舍人，並加為從五品。

translations.literal: Vice Ministers of the various bureaus and Gentlemen Attendants of the Palace Secretariat were all promoted to Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Ministers of the various bureaus and Gentlemen Attendants of the Palace Secretariat were all promoted to Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 增置通事舍人十二員，通舊為二十四員。

translations.literal: Twelve Gentlemen for General Service were added, making twenty-four in all with the existing posts.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Gentlemen for General Service were added, making twenty-four in all with the existing posts.

sentences.zh: 廢光祿寺及都水台入司農，廢衛尉入太常尚書省，廢鴻臚亦入太常。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Household and Directorate of Waterways were abolished and merged into the Court of National Granaries; the Guard Commandant was abolished and merged into the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Secretariat; State Ceremonial was also merged into Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Household and Directorate of Waterways were abolished and merged into the Court of National Granaries; the Guard Commandant was abolished and merged into the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Secretariat; State Ceremonial was also merged into Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 罷大理寺監、評及律博士員，加置正為四人。

translations.literal: The Supervisor and Evaluator of the Court of Judicial Review and Legal Erudite posts were abolished; Directors of Review were increased to four.
translations.idiomatic: The Supervisor and Evaluator of the Court of Judicial Review and Legal Erudite posts were abolished; Directors of Review were increased to four.

sentences.zh: 罷郡，以州統縣，改別駕、贊務，以為長史、司馬。

translations.literal: Commanderies were abolished; prefectures governed counties; Administrative Aides and Assistant Administrators were renamed Chief Administrator and Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Commanderies were abolished; prefectures governed counties; Administrative Aides and Assistant Administrators were renamed Chief Administrator and Administrator.

sentences.zh: 舊周、齊州郡縣職，自州都、郡縣正已下，皆州郡將縣令至而調用，理時事。

translations.literal: Under the old Northern Zhou and Qi prefecture and county posts, from Provincial Chief and Commandery and County Chiefs downward, all were appointed and transferred by prefectural and commandery generals and county magistrates to manage current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old Northern Zhou and Qi prefecture and county posts, from Provincial Chief and Commandery and County Chiefs downward, all were appointed and transferred by prefectural and commandery generals and county magistrates to manage current affairs.

sentences.zh: 至是不知時事，直謂之鄉官。

translations.literal: From this point they no longer managed current affairs and were simply called local officials.
translations.idiomatic: From this point they no longer managed current affairs and were simply called local officials.

sentences.zh: 別置品官，皆吏部除授，每歲考殿最。

translations.literal: Separate ranked officials were appointed, all selected and appointed by the Ministry of Personnel, with annual evaluation of performance.
translations.idiomatic: Separate ranked officials were appointed, all selected and appointed by the Ministry of Personnel, with annual evaluation of performance.

sentences.zh: 刺史、縣令，三年一遷，佐官四年一遷。

translations.literal: Regional Inspectors and Magistrates were transferred every three years; aide officials every four years.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Inspectors and Magistrates were transferred every three years; aide officials every four years.

sentences.zh: 佐官以曹為名者，並改為司。

translations.literal: Aide officials whose bureaus were named Cao were all renamed Si.
translations.idiomatic: Aide officials whose bureaus were named Cao were all renamed Si.

sentences.zh: 六年，尚書省二十四司，各置員外郎一人，以司其曹之籍帳。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, each of the twenty-four bureaus of the Secretariat appointed one Supernumerary Vice Minister to manage the bureau registers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, each of the twenty-four bureaus of the Secretariat appointed one Supernumerary Vice Minister to manage the bureau registers.

sentences.zh: 侍郎闕，則厘其曹事。

translations.literal: When a Vice Minister was absent, he managed the bureau affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When a Vice Minister was absent, he managed the bureau affairs.

sentences.zh: 吏部又別置朝議、通議、朝請、朝散、給事、承奉、儒林、文林等八郎，武騎、屯騎、驍騎、遊騎、飛騎、旅騎、雲騎、羽騎八尉。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel also separately appointed eight Gentlemen: Court Discussion, General Discussion, Court Request, Court Dispersal, Supervising Secretary, Presentation, Forest of Letters, and Forest of Literature; and eight Commandants: Martial Cavalry, Garrison Cavalry, Valiant Cavalry, Roaming Cavalry, Flying Cavalry, Travel Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Feather Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel also separately appointed eight Gentlemen: Court Discussion, General Discussion, Court Request, Court Dispersal, Supervising Secretary, Presentation, Forest of Letters, and Forest of Literature; and eight Commandants: Martial Cavalry, Garrison Cavalry, Valiant Cavalry, Roaming Cavalry, Flying Cavalry, Travel Cavalry, Cloud Cavalry, and Feather Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 其品則正六品以下，從九品以上。

translations.literal: Their ranks ranged from Regular Sixth Rank downward to Secondary Ninth Rank upward.
translations.idiomatic: Their ranks ranged from Regular Sixth Rank downward to Secondary Ninth Rank upward.

sentences.zh: 上階為郎，下階為尉。

translations.literal: The upper sub-ranks were Gentlemen; the lower sub-ranks were Commandants.
translations.idiomatic: The upper sub-ranks were Gentlemen; the lower sub-ranks were Commandants.

sentences.zh: 散官番直，常出使監檢。

translations.literal: Honorary officials stood rotation duty and were often sent out on inspection missions.
translations.idiomatic: Honorary officials stood rotation duty and were often sent out on inspection missions.

sentences.zh: 罷門下省員外散騎常侍、奉朝請、通事令史員，及左右衛、殿內將軍，司馬督，武騎常侍等員。

translations.literal: Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Unattached Cavalry, Gentlemen in Attendance at Court, General Clerks of the Chancellery, and posts of the Left and Right Guards, Palace Interior Generals, Marshal Supervisors, Regular Attendant of Martial Cavalry, and others were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Unattached Cavalry, Gentlemen in Attendance at Court, General Clerks of the Chancellery, and posts of the Left and Right Guards, Palace Interior Generals, Marshal Supervisors, Regular Attendant of Martial Cavalry, and others were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十二年，複置光祿、衛尉、鴻臚等寺。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the courts of Imperial Household, Guard Commandant, and State Ceremonial were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, the courts of Imperial Household, Guard Commandant, and State Ceremonial were restored.

sentences.zh: 諸州司以從事為名者，改為參軍。

translations.literal: Prefectural bureaus named Aide were renamed Aide-de-Camp.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural bureaus named Aide were renamed Aide-de-Camp.

sentences.zh: 十三年，複置都水台。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the Directorate of Waterways was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, the Directorate of Waterways was restored.

sentences.zh: 國子寺罷隸太常，又改寺為學。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Education ceased to be subordinate to Imperial Sacrifices, and the directorate was renamed a school.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Education ceased to be subordinate to Imperial Sacrifices, and the directorate was renamed a school.

sentences.zh: 十四年，諸省各置主事令史員。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, each department appointed Chief Clerk posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, each department appointed Chief Clerk posts.

sentences.zh: 改九等州縣為上、中、中下、下，凡四等。

translations.literal: The nine-grade prefectures and counties were changed to upper, middle, middle-lower, and lower—four grades in all.
translations.idiomatic: The nine-grade prefectures and counties were changed to upper, middle, middle-lower, and lower—four grades in all.

sentences.zh: 十五年，罷州縣、鄉官。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, prefecture, county, and local officials were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, prefecture, county, and local officials were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十六年，內侍省加置內主事員二十人，以承門閣。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, the Department of Palace Domestic Service added twenty Inner Chief Clerk posts to receive visitors at gates and pavilions.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, the Department of Palace Domestic Service added twenty Inner Chief Clerk posts to receive visitors at gates and pavilions.

sentences.zh: 十八年，置備身府。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the Bodyguard Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, the Bodyguard Office was established.

sentences.zh: 二十年，改將作寺為監，以大匠為大監。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, the Directorate of Palace Construction was changed to a Directorate, with the Master Builder as Grand Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, the Directorate of Palace Construction was changed to a Directorate, with the Master Builder as Grand Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 初加置副監。

translations.literal: Deputy Supervisors were initially added.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Supervisors were initially added.

sentences.zh: 仁壽元年，改都水台為監，更名使者為監。

translations.literal: In the first year of Renshou, the Directorate of Waterways was changed to a Directorate, and Commissioners were renamed Supervisors.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Renshou, the Directorate of Waterways was changed to a Directorate, and Commissioners were renamed Supervisors.

sentences.zh: 罷國子學，唯立太學一所，置博士五人，從五品，學生七十二人。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Education was abolished; only one Grand Learning school was established, with five Erudites of Secondary Fifth Rank and seventy-two students.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Education was abolished; only one Grand Learning school was established, with five Erudites of Secondary Fifth Rank and seventy-two students.

sentences.zh: 三年，監門府又置門候一百二十人。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Gate Guard office added one hundred twenty Gate Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, the Gate Guard office added one hundred twenty Gate Attendants.

sentences.zh: 尚書省六曹，各侍郎一人，以貳尚書之職。

translations.literal: Each of the six bureaus of the Secretariat had one Vice Minister to assist the Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the six bureaus of the Secretariat had one Vice Minister to assist the Ministers.

sentences.zh: 又增左、右丞階，與六侍郎並正四品。

translations.literal: The ranks of the Left and Right Assistant Directors were also raised, making them and the six Vice Ministers all Regular Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The ranks of the Left and Right Assistant Directors were also raised, making them and the six Vice Ministers all Regular Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 諸曹侍郎並改為郎。

translations.literal: Vice Ministers of the various bureaus were all renamed Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Ministers of the various bureaus were all renamed Lang.

sentences.zh: 又改吏部為選部郎，戶部為人部郎，禮部為儀曹郎，兵部為兵曹郎，刑部為憲部郎，工部為起部郎，以異六侍郎之名，廢諸司員外郎，而每增置一曹郎，各為二員。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel was renamed Selection Bureau Lang, Households renamed Personnel Bureau Lang, Rites renamed Ceremonial Bureau Lang, War renamed Military Bureau Lang, Punishments renamed Legal Bureau Lang, and Public Works renamed Construction Bureau Lang, to distinguish them from the six Vice Ministers; Supernumerary Vice Ministers of the various bureaus were abolished, and one additional bureau Lang was added to each, two in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel was renamed Selection Bureau Lang, Households renamed Personnel Bureau Lang, Rites renamed Ceremonial Bureau Lang, War renamed Military Bureau Lang, Punishments renamed Legal Bureau Lang, and Public Works renamed Construction Bureau Lang, to distinguish them from the six Vice Ministers; Supernumerary Vice Ministers of the various bureaus were abolished, and one additional bureau Lang was added to each, two in all.

sentences.zh: 都司郎各一人，品同曹郎，掌都事之職，以都事為正八品，分隸六尚書。

translations.literal: One Chief Affairs Lang was appointed for each bureau, equal in rank to the bureau Lang, managing the duties of the Chief Clerks; Chief Clerks became Regular Eighth Rank and were distributed among the six Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: One Chief Affairs Lang was appointed for each bureau, equal in rank to the bureau Lang, managing the duties of the Chief Clerks; Chief Clerks became Regular Eighth Rank and were distributed among the six Ministers.

sentences.zh: 諸司主事，並去令史之名。

translations.literal: Chief Clerks of the various bureaus all dropped the name Ling Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerks of the various bureaus all dropped the name Ling Shi.

sentences.zh: 其令史隨曹閑劇而置。

translations.literal: Ling Shi were appointed according to the busyness or leisure of each bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Ling Shi were appointed according to the busyness or leisure of each bureau.

sentences.zh: 每十令史置一主事，不滿十者亦置一人。

translations.literal: For every ten Ling Shi, one Chief Clerk was appointed; where there were fewer than ten, one was still appointed.
translations.idiomatic: For every ten Ling Shi, one Chief Clerk was appointed; where there were fewer than ten, one was still appointed.

sentences.zh: 其餘四省三台，亦皆曰令史，九寺五監諸衛府，則皆曰府史。

translations.literal: The other four departments and three bureaus also all used the name Ling Shi; the nine courts, five directorates, and various guard offices all used the name Fu Shi.
translations.idiomatic: The other four departments and three bureaus also all used the name Ling Shi; the nine courts, five directorates, and various guard offices all used the name Fu Shi.

sentences.zh: 後又改主客郎為司蕃郎。

translations.literal: Soon the Receiving Guests Lang was renamed Foreign Affairs Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Receiving Guests Lang was renamed Foreign Affairs Lang.

sentences.zh: 尋又每減一郎，置承務郎一人，同員外之職。

translations.literal: Soon one Lang was reduced from each bureau, and one Associate Clerk was appointed, with duties like a Supernumerary Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Soon one Lang was reduced from each bureau, and one Associate Clerk was appointed, with duties like a Supernumerary Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 舊都督已上，至上柱國，凡十一等，及八郎、八尉、四十三號將軍官，皆罷之。

translations.literal: The old ranks from Area Commander upward to Supreme Pillar of State—eleven grades in all—and the eight Gentlemen, eight Commandants, and forty-three designation generals were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The old ranks from Area Commander upward to Supreme Pillar of State—eleven grades in all—and the eight Gentlemen, eight Commandants, and forty-three designation generals were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 並省朝議大夫。

translations.literal: Court Discussion Grand Master was also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Court Discussion Grand Master was also abolished.

sentences.zh: 自一品至九品，置光祿、從一品。

translations.literal: From First Rank to Ninth Rank, Splendid Happiness was established; Secondary First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: From First Rank to Ninth Rank, Splendid Happiness was established; Secondary First Rank.

sentences.zh: 左右光祿、左正二品，右從二品。

translations.literal: Left and Right Splendid Happiness: Left Regular Second Rank, Right Secondary Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Splendid Happiness: Left Regular Second Rank, Right Secondary Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 金紫、正三品。

translations.literal: Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon: Regular Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon: Regular Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 銀青光祿、從三品。

translations.literal: Silver Seal and Blue Splendid Happiness: Secondary Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Silver Seal and Blue Splendid Happiness: Secondary Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 正議、正四品。

translations.literal: Court Discussion: Regular Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Court Discussion: Regular Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 通議、從四品。

translations.literal: General Discussion: Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: General Discussion: Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 朝請、正五品。

translations.literal: Court Request: Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Court Request: Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 朝散從五品。

translations.literal: Court Dispersal: Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Court Dispersal: Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 等九大夫，建節、正六品。

translations.literal: Establishing Staff: Regular Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Establishing Staff: Regular Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 奮武、從六品。

translations.literal: Striving Martial: Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Striving Martial: Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 宣惠、正七品。

translations.literal: Spreading Favor: Regular Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Spreading Favor: Regular Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 綏德、從七品。

translations.literal: Pacifying Virtue: Secondary Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying Virtue held Secondary Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 懷仁、正八品。

translations.literal: Cherishing Benevolence: Regular Eighth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Cherishing Benevolence held Regular Eighth Rank.

sentences.zh: 守義、從八品。

translations.literal: Keeping Righteousness: Secondary Eighth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Keeping Righteousness held Secondary Eighth Rank.

sentences.zh: 奉誠、正九品。

translations.literal: Maintaining Sincerity: Regular Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Maintaining Sincerity held Regular Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 立信從九品。
