translations.literal: Establishing Trust: Secondary Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Establishing Trust held Secondary Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 等八尉，以為散職。

translations.literal: These eight Commandants served as honorary posts.
translations.idiomatic: These eight Commandants served as honorary posts.

sentences.zh: 開皇中，以開府儀同三司為四品散實官，至是改為從一品，同漢、魏之制，位次王公。

translations.literal: In the Kaihuang reign, Opener of the Office with Third Rank Equal Companionship was a Fourth Rank honorary substantive post; now it was changed to Secondary First Rank, following Han and Wei practice, ranking below princes and dukes.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaihuang reign, Opener of the Office with Third Rank Equal Companionship was a Fourth Rank honorary substantive post; now it was changed to Secondary First Rank, following Han and Wei practice, ranking below princes and dukes.

sentences.zh: 門下省減給事黃門侍郎員，置二人，去給事之名，移吏部給事郎名為門下之職，位次黃門下。

translations.literal: The Chancellery reduced Supervising Secretaries of the Yellow Gate and appointed two, removing the Supervising Secretary name; the Ministry of Personnel's Gentlemen Attendant title was moved to the Chancellery, ranking below the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellery reduced Supervising Secretaries of the Yellow Gate and appointed two, removing the Supervising Secretary name; the Ministry of Personnel's Gentlemen Attendant title was moved to the Chancellery, ranking below the Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 置員四人，從五品，省讀奉案。

translations.literal: Four posts were appointed, Secondary Fifth Rank, reviewing memorials and cases.
translations.idiomatic: Four posts were appointed, Secondary Fifth Rank, reviewing memorials and cases.

sentences.zh: 廢散騎常侍、通直散騎常侍、諫議大夫、散騎侍郎等常員。

translations.literal: Regular Attendant of the Unattached Cavalry, Regular Attendant of Direct Communication of the Unattached Cavalry, Remonstrating Grand Master, Gentleman of the Unattached Cavalry, and other regular posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Regular Attendant of the Unattached Cavalry, Regular Attendant of Direct Communication of the Unattached Cavalry, Remonstrating Grand Master, Gentleman of the Unattached Cavalry, and other regular posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 改符璽監為郎，置員二人，為從六品。

translations.literal: The Seals and Credentials Supervisor was renamed Lang, with two posts, Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Seals and Credentials Supervisor was renamed Lang, with two posts, Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 加錄事階為正八品。

translations.literal: The Recorder rank was raised to Regular Eighth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Recorder rank was raised to Regular Eighth Rank.

sentences.zh: 以城門、殿內、尚食、尚藥、禦府等五局隸殿內省。

translations.literal: The five bureaus of City Gates, Palace Interior, Imperial Food Service, Imperial Pharmacy, and Imperial Wardrobe were placed under the Department of the Palace Interior.
translations.idiomatic: The five bureaus of City Gates, Palace Interior, Imperial Food Service, Imperial Pharmacy, and Imperial Wardrobe were placed under the Department of the Palace Interior.

sentences.zh: 十二年，又改納言為侍內。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Remonstrator was again renamed Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Remonstrator was again renamed Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 內史省減侍郎員為二人，減內史舍人員為四人。

translations.literal: The Palace Secretariat reduced Vice Directors to two and Gentlemen Attendants to four.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Secretariat reduced Vice Directors to two and Gentlemen Attendants to four.

sentences.zh: 加置起居舍人員二人，從六品。

translations.literal: Two Gentlemen Attendants for Daily Record were added, Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Gentlemen Attendants for Daily Record were added, Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 次舍人下。

translations.literal: They ranked below Gentlemen Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: They ranked below Gentlemen Attendants.

sentences.zh: 改通事舍人員為謁者台職。

translations.literal: Gentlemen for General Service were changed to posts of the Bureau of Ushers.
translations.idiomatic: Gentlemen for General Service were changed to posts of the Bureau of Ushers.

sentences.zh: 減主書員，置四人，加為正八品。

translations.literal: Master Scribes were reduced to four, promoted to Regular Eighth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Master Scribes were reduced to four, promoted to Regular Eighth Rank.

sentences.zh: 十二年，改內史為內書。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Palace Secretariat was renamed Inner Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Palace Secretariat was renamed Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 殿內省置監、正四品。

translations.literal: The Department of the Palace Interior appointed one Supervisor, Regular Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of the Palace Interior appointed one Supervisor, Regular Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 少監、從四品。

translations.literal: Deputy Supervisor, Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Supervisor held Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 丞，從五品。

translations.literal: Assistant Director, Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Director held Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 各一人，掌諸供奉。

translations.literal: One each, managing all attendance and supply.
translations.idiomatic: One each, managing all attendance and supply.

sentences.zh: 又有奉車都尉十二人，掌進禦輿馬。

translations.literal: There were also twelve Commandants of Chariots in Attendance, managing imperial chariots and horses.
translations.idiomatic: There were also twelve Commandants of Chariots in Attendance, managing imperial chariots and horses.

sentences.zh: 統尚食、尚藥、尚衣、尚舍、尚乘、尚輦等六局，各置奉禦二人，正五品。

translations.literal: It oversaw the six bureaus of Imperial Food Service, Imperial Pharmacy, Imperial Garments, Imperial Quarters, Imperial Mounts, and Imperial Palanquin, each with two Palace Stewards, Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw the six bureaus of Imperial Food Service, Imperial Pharmacy, Imperial Garments, Imperial Quarters, Imperial Mounts, and Imperial Palanquin, each with two Palace Stewards, Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 皆置直長，以貳之。

translations.literal: Each also had Duty Chiefs as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Each also had Duty Chiefs as deputies.

sentences.zh: 正七品。

translations.literal: Regular Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: They held Regular Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 尚食直長六人，又有食醫員。

translations.literal: Imperial Food Service had six Duty Chiefs, and also Dietary Physician posts.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Food Service had six Duty Chiefs, and also Dietary Physician posts.

sentences.zh: 尚藥直長四人，又有侍御醫、司醫、醫佐員。

translations.literal: Imperial Pharmacy had four Duty Chiefs, and also Attending Physician, Medical Officer, and Medical Assistant posts.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Pharmacy had four Duty Chiefs, and also Attending Physician, Medical Officer, and Medical Assistant posts.

sentences.zh: 尚衣即舊禦府也，改名之，有直長四人。

translations.literal: Imperial Garments was the old Imperial Wardrobe, renamed; it had four Duty Chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Garments was the old Imperial Wardrobe, renamed; it had four Duty Chiefs.

sentences.zh: 尚舍即舊殿中局也，改名之，有直長八人。

translations.literal: Imperial Quarters was the old Palace Interior Bureau, renamed; it had eight Duty Chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Quarters was the old Palace Interior Bureau, renamed; it had eight Duty Chiefs.

sentences.zh: 尚乘局置左右六閑：一左右飛黃閑，二左右吉良閑，三左右龍媒閑，四左右騊駼閑，五左右駃騠閑，六左右天苑閑。

translations.literal: The Imperial Mounts Bureau established six stables at left and right: first, Left and Right Flying Yellow; second, Left and Right Auspicious Fine; third, Left and Right Dragon Matchmaker; fourth, Left and Right Taotu; fifth, Left and Right Kuiqi; sixth, Left and Right Heavenly Park.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Mounts Bureau established six stables at left and right: first, Left and Right Flying Yellow; second, Left and Right Auspicious Fine; third, Left and Right Dragon Matchmaker; fourth, Left and Right Taotu; fifth, Left and Right Kuiqi; sixth, Left and Right Heavenly Park.

sentences.zh: 有直長十四人，又有奉乘十人。

translations.literal: There were fourteen Duty Chiefs, and also ten Chariot Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: There were fourteen Duty Chiefs, and also ten Chariot Attendants.

sentences.zh: 尚輦有直長四人，又有掌輦六人。

translations.literal: Imperial Palanquin had four Duty Chiefs, and also six Palanquin Bearers.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Palanquin had four Duty Chiefs, and also six Palanquin Bearers.

sentences.zh: 城門置校尉一人，降為正五品。

translations.literal: The City Gates Bureau had one Captain, reduced to Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The City Gates Bureau had one Captain, reduced to Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 後又改校尉為城門郎，置員四人，從六品。

translations.literal: Later the Captain was renamed City Gate Lang, with four posts, Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Captain was renamed City Gate Lang, with four posts, Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 自殿內省隸為門下省官。

translations.literal: It was removed from the Department of the Palace Interior and made a Chancellery office.
translations.idiomatic: It was removed from the Department of the Palace Interior and made a Chancellery office.

sentences.zh: 秘書省降監為從三品，增置少監一人。

translations.literal: The Imperial Library reduced the Supervisor to Secondary Third Rank and added one Deputy Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Library reduced the Supervisor to Secondary Third Rank and added one Deputy Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 從四品。

translations.literal: Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Supervisor held Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 增著作郎階為正五品，減校書郎為十人。

translations.literal: The rank of Gentleman of Compilation was raised to Regular Fifth Rank, and Collators were reduced to ten.
translations.idiomatic: The rank of Gentleman of Compilation was raised to Regular Fifth Rank, and Collators were reduced to ten.

sentences.zh: 改太史局為監，進令階為從五品，又減丞為一人。

translations.literal: The Grand Astrologer Bureau was changed to a Directorate; the Director's rank was raised to Secondary Fifth Rank, and Assistant Directors were reduced to one.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Astrologer Bureau was changed to a Directorate; the Director's rank was raised to Secondary Fifth Rank, and Assistant Directors were reduced to one.

sentences.zh: 置司辰師八人，增置監候為十人。

translations.literal: Eight Timekeepers were appointed, and Observatory Attendants were increased to ten.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Timekeepers were appointed, and Observatory Attendants were increased to ten.

sentences.zh: 其後又改監、少監為令、少令。

translations.literal: Later Supervisor and Deputy Supervisor were again renamed Director and Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Later Supervisor and Deputy Supervisor were again renamed Director and Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 增秘書郎為從五品，加置佐郎四人，從六品。

translations.literal: Gentlemen of the Imperial Library were raised to Secondary Fifth Rank, and four Assistant Gentlemen were added, Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Gentlemen of the Imperial Library were raised to Secondary Fifth Rank, and four Assistant Gentlemen were added, Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 以貳郎之職。

translations.literal: They served as deputies to the Gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: They served as deputies to the Gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 降著作郎階為從五品。

translations.literal: The rank of Gentleman of Compilation was reduced to Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The rank of Gentleman of Compilation was reduced to Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 又置儒林郎十人，正七品。

translations.literal: Ten Forest of Letters Gentlemen were also appointed, Regular Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Forest of Letters Gentlemen were also appointed, Regular Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 掌明經待問，唯詔所使。

translations.literal: They clarified the Classics and answered inquiries, acting only on imperial command.
translations.idiomatic: They clarified the Classics and answered inquiries, acting only on imperial command.

sentences.zh: 文林郎二十人，從八品。

translations.literal: Twenty Forest of Literature Gentlemen, Secondary Eighth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty Forest of Literature Gentlemen held Secondary Eighth Rank.

sentences.zh: 掌撰錄文史，檢討舊事。

translations.literal: They compiled and recorded literary and historical materials and examined past events.
translations.idiomatic: They compiled and recorded literary and historical materials and examined past events.

sentences.zh: 此二郎皆上在籓已來直司學士。

translations.literal: These two Lang ranks were academicians who had served the emperor since his time as heir.
translations.idiomatic: These two Lang ranks were academicians who had served the emperor since his time as heir.

sentences.zh: 增校書郎員四十人，加置楷書郎員二十人，從九品。

translations.literal: Collators were increased to forty, and twenty Copyist Lang were added, Secondary Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Collators were increased to forty, and twenty Copyist Lang were added, Secondary Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 掌抄寫禦書。

translations.literal: They copied imperial books.
translations.idiomatic: They copied imperial books.

sentences.zh: 御史台增治書侍御史為正五品。

translations.literal: The Censorate raised Attending Secretaries for Legal Documents to Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate raised Attending Secretaries for Legal Documents to Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 省殿內御史員，增監察御史員十六人，加階為從七品。

translations.literal: Attending Censors for the Palace Interior were abolished; Investigating Censors were increased to sixteen and promoted to Secondary Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Attending Censors for the Palace Interior were abolished; Investigating Censors were increased to sixteen and promoted to Secondary Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 開皇中，御史直宿禁中，至是罷其制。

translations.literal: In the Kaihuang reign, censors stood night duty in the Forbidden Palace; now that practice was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaihuang reign, censors stood night duty in the Forbidden Palace; now that practice was abolished.

sentences.zh: 又置主簿、錄事員各二人。

translations.literal: Chief Secretary and Recorder posts, two each, were also appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Secretary and Recorder posts, two each, were also appointed.

sentences.zh: 五年，又降大夫階為正四品，減治書侍御史為從五品；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Grand Censor's rank was reduced to Regular Fourth Rank, and Attending Secretaries for Legal Documents to Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, the Grand Censor's rank was reduced to Regular Fourth Rank, and Attending Secretaries for Legal Documents to Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 增侍御史為正七品，唯掌侍從糾察，其台中簿領，皆治書侍御史主之。

translations.literal: Attending Censors were raised to Regular Seventh Rank and were responsible only for attendance and investigation; all bureau records within the Censorate were managed by Attending Secretaries for Legal Documents.
translations.idiomatic: Attending Censors were raised to Regular Seventh Rank and were responsible only for attendance and investigation; all bureau records within the Censorate were managed by Attending Secretaries for Legal Documents.

sentences.zh: 後又增置御史，從九品，尋又省。

translations.literal: Censors were later added, Secondary Ninth Rank, but soon abolished again.
translations.idiomatic: Censors were later added, Secondary Ninth Rank, but soon abolished again.

sentences.zh: 謁者台大夫一人，從四品。

translations.literal: Grand Master of the Bureau of Ushers, Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Master of the Bureau of Ushers held Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 五年，改為正四品。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, it was changed to Regular Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, it was changed to Regular Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 掌受詔勞問，出使慰撫，持節察授，及受冤枉而申奏之。

translations.literal: He received edicts for condolences and inquiries, went on missions to comfort and soothe, bore the Staff of Authority for inspection and appointment, and received grievances to report upward.
translations.idiomatic: He received edicts for condolences and inquiries, went on missions to comfort and soothe, bore the Staff of Authority for inspection and appointment, and received grievances to report upward.

sentences.zh: 駕出，對御史引駕。

translations.literal: When the emperor went out, he paired with the Censor to lead the procession.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor went out, he paired with the Censor to lead the procession.

sentences.zh: 置司朝謁者二人以貳之。

translations.literal: Two Court Attending Ushers were appointed as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Two Court Attending Ushers were appointed as deputies.

sentences.zh: 從五品。

translations.literal: Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: They held Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 屬官有丞一人，主簿、錄事各一人等員。

translations.literal: Subordinate officials included one Assistant Director, one Chief Secretary, and one Recorder, and so on.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate officials included one Assistant Director, one Chief Secretary, and one Recorder, and so on.

sentences.zh: 又有通事謁者二十人，從六品。

translations.literal: There were also twenty Gentlemen Ushers for General Service, Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were also twenty Gentlemen Ushers for General Service, Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 即內史通事舍人之職也。

translations.literal: These were the duties of the Gentlemen for General Service of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: These were the duties of the Gentlemen for General Service of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 次有議郎二十四人，通直三十六人，將事謁者三十人，謁者七十人，皆掌出使。

translations.literal: Next were twenty-four Discussion Lang, thirty-six Direct Communication Lang, thirty Gentlemen Ushers for General Service, and seventy Ushers—all charged with going on missions.
translations.idiomatic: Next were twenty-four Discussion Lang, thirty-six Direct Communication Lang, thirty Gentlemen Ushers for General Service, and seventy Ushers—all charged with going on missions.

sentences.zh: 其後廢議郎，通直、將事謁者，謁者等員，而置員外郎八十員。

translations.literal: Later Discussion Lang, Direct Communication Lang, Gentlemen Ushers for General Service, and Usher posts were abolished, and eighty Supernumerary Vice Ministers were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Later Discussion Lang, Direct Communication Lang, Gentlemen Ushers for General Service, and Usher posts were abolished, and eighty Supernumerary Vice Ministers were appointed.

sentences.zh: 尋詔門下、內史、御史、司隸、謁者五司，監受表，以為恆式，不復專謁者矣。

translations.literal: Soon an edict made the Chancellery, Palace Secretariat, Censorate, Directorate of Corrections, and Bureau of Ushers five offices to receive memorials as a permanent practice, and Ushers no longer had exclusive charge.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict made the Chancellery, Palace Secretariat, Censorate, Directorate of Corrections, and Bureau of Ushers five offices to receive memorials as a permanent practice, and Ushers no longer had exclusive charge.

sentences.zh: 尋又置散騎郎，從五品，二十人，承議郎、正六品。

translations.literal: Soon Unattached Cavalry Lang were appointed, Secondary Fifth Rank, twenty persons; Presentation Lang, Regular Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Unattached Cavalry Lang were appointed, Secondary Fifth Rank, twenty persons; Presentation Lang, Regular Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 通直郎，從六品。

translations.literal: Direct Communication Lang, Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Direct Communication Lang held Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 各三十人，宣德郎、正七品。

translations.literal: Thirty each; Spreading Virtue Lang, Regular Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty each; Spreading Virtue Lang held Regular Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 宣義郎，從七品，各四十人，從事郎、正八品。

translations.literal: Spreading Righteousness Lang, Secondary Seventh Rank, forty each; Attending Lang, Regular Eighth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Spreading Righteousness Lang, Secondary Seventh Rank, forty each; Attending Lang, Regular Eighth Rank.

sentences.zh: 將仕郎、從八品。

translations.literal: Awaiting Appointment Lang, Secondary Eighth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Awaiting Appointment Lang held Secondary Eighth Rank.

sentences.zh: 常從郎、正九品。

translations.literal: Regular Attendance Lang, Regular Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Regular Attendance Lang held Regular Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 奉信郎，從九品。

translations.literal: Trustworthy Attendance Lang, Secondary Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Trustworthy Attendance Lang held Secondary Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 各五十人，是為正員。

translations.literal: Fifty each—these were the regular posts.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty each—these were the regular posts.

sentences.zh: 並得祿當品。

translations.literal: All received salary according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: All received salary according to rank.

sentences.zh: 又各有散員郎，無員無祿。

translations.literal: Each also had Supernumerary Lang with no fixed quota and no salary.
translations.idiomatic: Each also had Supernumerary Lang with no fixed quota and no salary.

sentences.zh: 尋改常從為登仕，奉信為散從。

translations.literal: Soon Regular Attendance was renamed Entering Service, and Trustworthy Attendance was renamed Dispersed Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Regular Attendance was renamed Entering Service, and Trustworthy Attendance was renamed Dispersed Attendance.

sentences.zh: 自散騎已下，皆主出使，量事大小，據品以發之。

translations.literal: From Unattached Cavalry downward, all were charged with going on missions, dispatching personnel according to rank according to the size of the task.
translations.idiomatic: From Unattached Cavalry downward, all were charged with going on missions, dispatching personnel according to rank according to the size of the task.

sentences.zh: 司隸台大夫一人，正四品。

translations.literal: Grand Master of the Directorate of Corrections, Regular Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Master of the Directorate of Corrections held Regular Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 掌諸巡察。

translations.literal: He managed all inspection and investigation.
translations.idiomatic: He managed all inspection and investigation.

sentences.zh: 別駕二人，從五品。

translations.literal: Two Administrative Aides, Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Administrative Aides held Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 分察畿內，一人案東都，一人案京師。

translations.literal: They divided inspection within the capital region; one investigated the Eastern Capital, one the capital.
translations.idiomatic: They divided inspection within the capital region; one investigated the Eastern Capital, one the capital.

sentences.zh: 刺史十四人，正六品。

translations.literal: Fourteen Regional Inspectors, Regular Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Regional Inspectors held Regular Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 巡察畿外。

translations.literal: They inspected outside the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: They inspected outside the capital region.

sentences.zh: 諸郡從事四十人，副刺史巡察。

translations.literal: Forty Commandery Aides assisted the Regional Inspectors in inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Forty Commandery Aides assisted the Regional Inspectors in inspection.

sentences.zh: 其所掌六條：一察品官以上理政能不。

translations.literal: They were charged with six categories: first, to inspect whether ranked officials of third rank and above governed effectively.
translations.idiomatic: They were charged with six categories: first, to inspect whether ranked officials of third rank and above governed effectively.

sentences.zh: 二察官人貪殘害政。

translations.literal: Second, to inspect whether officials were greedy, cruel, and harmful in government.
translations.idiomatic: Second, to inspect whether officials were greedy, cruel, and harmful in government.

sentences.zh: 三察豪強奸猾，侵害下人，及田宅逾制，官司不能禁止者。

translations.literal: Third, to inspect powerful families and cunning persons who oppressed commoners, and those whose fields and residences exceeded regulations whom officials could not restrain.
translations.idiomatic: Third, to inspect powerful families and cunning persons who oppressed commoners, and those whose fields and residences exceeded regulations whom officials could not restrain.

sentences.zh: 四察水旱蟲災，不以實言，枉征賦役，及無災妄蠲免者。

translations.literal: Fourth, to inspect those who did not report floods, droughts, insects, and disasters truthfully, wrongly levied corvée and taxes, or falsely granted tax relief where there was no disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, to inspect those who did not report floods, droughts, insects, and disasters truthfully, wrongly levied corvée and taxes, or falsely granted tax relief where there was no disaster.

sentences.zh: 五察部內賊盜，不能窮逐，隱而不申者。

translations.literal: Fifth, to inspect thieves and bandits within the jurisdiction who could not be pursued and captured, or were concealed and not reported.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, to inspect thieves and bandits within the jurisdiction who could not be pursued and captured, or were concealed and not reported.

sentences.zh: 六察德行孝悌，茂才異行，隱不貢者。

translations.literal: Sixth, to inspect those of virtuous conduct, filial piety, and exceptional talent who were concealed and not recommended.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, to inspect those of virtuous conduct, filial piety, and exceptional talent who were concealed and not recommended.

sentences.zh: 每年二月，乘軺巡郡縣，十月入奏。

translations.literal: Every year in the second month they rode light carriages to inspect commanderies and counties, and in the tenth month entered court to report.
translations.idiomatic: Every year in the second month they rode light carriages to inspect commanderies and counties, and in the tenth month entered court to report.

sentences.zh: 置丞、從六品。

translations.literal: One Assistant Director was appointed, Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Assistant Director was appointed, Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 主簿、從八品。

translations.literal: Chief Secretary, Secondary Eighth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Secretary held Secondary Eighth Rank.

sentences.zh: 錄事從九品。

translations.literal: Recorder, Secondary Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Recorder held Secondary Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 各一人，後又罷司隸台，而留司隸從事之名，不為常員。

translations.literal: One each; later the Directorate of Corrections was abolished, but the name Corrections Aide was retained, not as a regular post.
translations.idiomatic: One each; later the Directorate of Corrections was abolished, but the name Corrections Aide was retained, not as a regular post.

sentences.zh: 臨時選京官清明者，權攝以行。

translations.literal: Capital officials of integrity were temporarily selected and appointed to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials of integrity were temporarily selected and appointed to serve.

sentences.zh: 光祿已下八寺卿，皆降為從三品。

translations.literal: Ministers of the eight courts from Imperial Household downward were all reduced to Secondary Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers of the eight courts from Imperial Household downward were all reduced to Secondary Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 少卿各加置二人，為從四品。

translations.literal: Two Vice Ministers were added to each, Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Vice Ministers were added to each, Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 諸寺上署令，並增為正六品，中署令為從六品，下置令為正七品。

translations.literal: Directors of upper directorates were all raised to Regular Sixth Rank; middle directorates to Secondary Sixth Rank; lower directorates to Regular Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Directors of upper directorates were all raised to Regular Sixth Rank; middle directorates to Secondary Sixth Rank; lower directorates to Regular Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 始開皇中，署司唯典掌受納，至是署令為判首，取二卿判。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaihuang, directorate bureaus only managed receipt and disbursement; now the Director was the chief deciding officer, taking decisions from the two Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaihuang, directorate bureaus only managed receipt and disbursement; now the Director was the chief deciding officer, taking decisions from the two Ministers.

sentences.zh: 丞唯知勾檢。

translations.literal: Assistant Directors only managed verification.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Directors only managed verification.

sentences.zh: 令闕，丞判。

translations.literal: When the Director was absent, the Assistant Director decided.
translations.idiomatic: When the Director was absent, the Assistant Director decided.

sentences.zh: 五年，寺丞並增為從五品。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, court Assistant Directors were all raised to Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, court Assistant Directors were all raised to Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 太常寺罷太祝署，而留太祝員八人，屬寺。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices abolished the Grand Sacrificers Directorate but retained eight Grand Sacrificer posts, subordinate to the court.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices abolished the Grand Sacrificers Directorate but retained eight Grand Sacrificer posts, subordinate to the court.

sentences.zh: 後又增為十人。

translations.literal: Later they were increased to ten.
translations.idiomatic: Later they were increased to ten.

sentences.zh: 奉禮減置六人。

translations.literal: Ceremonial Gentlemen were reduced to six.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial Gentlemen were reduced to six.

sentences.zh: 太廟署又置陰室丞，守視陰室。

translations.literal: The Imperial Ancestral Temple Directorate also appointed an Assistant Director for the Inner Chamber, who guarded and watched the Inner Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Ancestral Temple Directorate also appointed an Assistant Director for the Inner Chamber, who guarded and watched the Inner Chamber.

sentences.zh: 改樂師為樂正，置十人。

translations.literal: Music Masters were renamed Music Directors, with ten appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Music Masters were renamed Music Directors, with ten appointed.

sentences.zh: 太卜又省博士員，置太卜卜正二十人，以掌其事。

translations.literal: Grand Divination also abolished Erudite posts and appointed twenty Grand Divination Directors to manage its affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Divination also abolished Erudite posts and appointed twenty Grand Divination Directors to manage its affairs.

sentences.zh: 太醫又置醫監五人，正十人。

translations.literal: Imperial Physicians also appointed five Medical Supervisors and ten Chief Physicians.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Physicians also appointed five Medical Supervisors and ten Chief Physicians.

sentences.zh: 罷衣冠、清商二署。

translations.literal: The Ceremonial Garments and Pure Music directorates were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Ceremonial Garments and Pure Music directorates were abolished.

sentences.zh: 太僕減驊騮署入殿內尚乘局，改龍廄曰典廄署，有左、右駁皁二廄。

translations.literal: Imperial Stud reduced the Piebald Horses Directorate and merged it into the Imperial Mounts Bureau of the Department of the Palace Interior; Dragon Stable was renamed Stud Administration Directorate, with Left and Right Piebald and Black stables.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Stud reduced the Piebald Horses Directorate and merged it into the Imperial Mounts Bureau of the Department of the Palace Interior; Dragon Stable was renamed Stud Administration Directorate, with Left and Right Piebald and Black stables.

sentences.zh: 加置主乘、司庫、司廩官。

translations.literal: Chief Charioteer, Treasury Officer, and Granary Officer were added.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Charioteer, Treasury Officer, and Granary Officer were added.

sentences.zh: 罷牛羊署。

translations.literal: The Cattle and Sheep Directorate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Cattle and Sheep Directorate was abolished.

sentences.zh: 大理寺丞改為勾檢官，增正員為六人，分判獄事。

translations.literal: Assistant Directors of the Court of Judicial Review were changed to verification officers; regular Directors were increased to six, dividing judgment of prison cases.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Directors of the Court of Judicial Review were changed to verification officers; regular Directors were increased to six, dividing judgment of prison cases.

sentences.zh: 置司直十六人，降為從六品，後加至二十人。

translations.literal: Sixteen Direct Investigators were appointed, reduced to Secondary Sixth Rank, later increased to twenty.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen Direct Investigators were appointed, reduced to Secondary Sixth Rank, later increased to twenty.

sentences.zh: 又置評事四十八人，掌頗同司直，正九品。

translations.literal: Forty-eight Evaluators were also appointed, with duties largely like Direct Investigators, Regular Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-eight Evaluators were also appointed, with duties largely like Direct Investigators, Regular Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 鴻臚寺改典客署為典蕃署。

translations.literal: The Court of State Ceremonial renamed the Receiving Guests Directorate as Foreign Affairs Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of State Ceremonial renamed the Receiving Guests Directorate as Foreign Affairs Directorate.

sentences.zh: 初煬帝置四方館於建國門外，以待四方使者，後罷之，有事則置，名隸鴻臚寺，量事繁簡，臨時損益。

translations.literal: Initially Emperor Yang established the Four Directions Hall outside the Jianguo Gate to receive envoys from all directions; later it was abolished and re-established as needed, subordinate to the Court of State Ceremonial, with staff adjusted according to the volume of business.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Emperor Yang established the Four Directions Hall outside the Jianguo Gate to receive envoys from all directions; later it was abolished and re-established as needed, subordinate to the Court of State Ceremonial, with staff adjusted according to the volume of business.

sentences.zh: 東方曰東夷使者，南方曰南蠻使者，西方曰西戎使者，北方曰北狄使者，各一人，掌其方國及互市事。

translations.literal: The east was called Eastern Yi Envoy, the south Southern Man Envoy, the west Western Rong Envoy, and the north Northern Di Envoy—one each, managing their respective regions and mutual trade.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys for the east, south, west, and north were called Eastern Yi, Southern Man, Western Rong, and Northern Di—one each, managing their regions and mutual trade.

sentences.zh: 每使者署，典護錄事、敘職、敘儀、監府、監置、互市監及副、參軍各一人。

translations.literal: Each envoy office had one Registry Chief, one Merit Officer, one Protocol Officer, one Ceremony Officer, one Tribute Supervisor, one Settlement Supervisor, one Mutual Trade Supervisor and Deputy, and one Aide-de-Camp.
translations.idiomatic: Each envoy office had one Registry Chief, one Merit Officer, one Protocol Officer, one Ceremony Officer, one Tribute Supervisor, one Settlement Supervisor, one Mutual Trade Supervisor and Deputy, and one Aide-de-Camp.

sentences.zh: 錄事主綱紀。

translations.literal: The Registry Chief managed records.
translations.idiomatic: The Registry Chief managed records.

sentences.zh: 敘職掌其貴賤立功合敘者。

translations.literal: The Merit Officer managed those of high and low status deserving merit records.
translations.idiomatic: The Merit Officer managed those of high and low status deserving merit records.

sentences.zh: 敘儀掌小大次序。

translations.literal: The Ceremony Officer managed the order of precedence.
translations.idiomatic: The Ceremony Officer managed the order of precedence.

sentences.zh: 監府掌其貢獻財貨。

translations.literal: The Tribute Supervisor managed tribute and goods.
translations.idiomatic: The Tribute Supervisor managed tribute and goods.

sentences.zh: 監置掌安置其駝馬船車，並糾察非違。

translations.literal: The Settlement Supervisor managed the placement of camels, horses, boats, and carts, and investigated violations.
translations.idiomatic: The Settlement Supervisor managed the placement of camels, horses, boats, and carts, and investigated violations.

sentences.zh: 互市監及副掌互市。

translations.literal: The Mutual Trade Supervisor and Deputy managed mutual trade.
translations.idiomatic: The Mutual Trade Supervisor and Deputy managed mutual trade.

sentences.zh: 參軍事出入交易。

translations.literal: The Aide-de-Camp managed incoming and outgoing transactions.
translations.idiomatic: The Aide-de-Camp managed incoming and outgoing transactions.

sentences.zh: 司農但統上林、太倉、鉤盾、導官四署，罷典農、華林二署，而以平准、京市隸太府。

translations.literal: The Court of National Granaries only oversaw Imperial Park, Grand Granary, Palace Guard Stores, and Food Processing directorates; State Farms and Orchard Park were abolished, and Price Equalization and Capital Market were placed under Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of National Granaries only oversaw Imperial Park, Grand Granary, Palace Guard Stores, and Food Processing directorates; State Farms and Orchard Park were abolished, and Price Equalization and Capital Market were placed under Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 太府寺既分為少府監，而但管京都市五署及平准、左右藏等，凡八署。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Treasury was divided into the Directorate of the Inner Palace, and only managed five Capital Market directorates and Price Equalization, Left and Right Treasuries—in all eight directorates.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Treasury was divided into the Directorate of the Inner Palace, and only managed five Capital Market directorates and Price Equalization, Left and Right Treasuries—in all eight directorates.

sentences.zh: 京師東市曰都會，西市曰利人。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital's eastern market was called Assembly; the western market was called Benefit to the People.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital's eastern market was called Assembly; the western market was called Benefit to the People.

sentences.zh: 東都東市曰豐都，南市曰大同，北市曰通遠。

translations.literal: The Eastern Capital's eastern market was called Abundance; the southern market Great Unity; the northern market Far Reach.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Capital's eastern market was called Abundance; the southern market Great Unity; the northern market Far Reach.

sentences.zh: 及改諸令為監，唯市署曰令。

translations.literal: When all Directors were changed to Supervisors, only the Market Directorate retained the title Director.
translations.idiomatic: When all Directors were changed to Supervisors, only the Market Directorate retained the title Director.

sentences.zh: 國子監依舊置祭酒，加置司業一人，從四品，丞三人，加為從六品。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Education was restored with a Libationer; one Vice Director of Secondary Fourth Rank and three Assistant Directors of Secondary Sixth Rank were added.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Education was restored with a Libationer; one Vice Director of Secondary Fourth Rank and three Assistant Directors of Secondary Sixth Rank were added.

sentences.zh: 並置主簿、錄事各一人。

translations.literal: Chief Secretary and Recorder, one each, were also appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Secretary and Recorder, one each, were also appointed.

sentences.zh: 國子學置博士，正五品，助教，從七品，員各一人。

translations.literal: The Imperial University appointed one Erudite of Regular Fifth Rank and one Assistant Instructor of Secondary Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial University appointed one Erudite of Regular Fifth Rank and one Assistant Instructor of Secondary Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 學生無常員，太學博士、助教各二人，學生五百人。

translations.literal: Students had no fixed quota; Grand Learning had two Erudites and two Assistant Instructors, with five hundred students.
translations.idiomatic: Students had no fixed quota; Grand Learning had two Erudites and two Assistant Instructors, with five hundred students.

sentences.zh: 先是仁壽元年，省國子祭酒、博士，置太學博士員五人，為從五品，總知學事。

translations.literal: Previously in the first year of Renshou, the Libationer and Erudites of the Directorate of Education were abolished; five Grand Learning Erudite posts of Secondary Fifth Rank were appointed to oversee all academic affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Previously in the first year of Renshou, the Libationer and Erudites of the Directorate of Education were abolished; five Grand Learning Erudite posts of Secondary Fifth Rank were appointed to oversee all academic affairs.

sentences.zh: 至是太學博士降為從六品。

translations.literal: At this point Grand Learning Erudites were reduced to Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Grand Learning Erudites were reduced to Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 將作監改大監、少監為大匠、少匠，丞加為從六品。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Palace Construction renamed Grand and Deputy Supervisors as Master and Vice Master Builder; Assistant Directors were raised to Secondary Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Palace Construction renamed Grand and Deputy Supervisors as Master and Vice Master Builder; Assistant Directors were raised to Secondary Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 統左右校及甄官署。

translations.literal: It oversaw the Left and Right Construction Offices and Casting Office.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw the Left and Right Construction Offices and Casting Office.

sentences.zh: 五年，又改大匠為大監，正四品，少匠為少監，正五品。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Master Builder was again renamed Grand Supervisor, Regular Fourth Rank; Vice Master Builder was renamed Deputy Supervisor, Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Master Builder was again renamed Grand Supervisor, Regular Fourth Rank; Vice Master Builder was renamed Deputy Supervisor, Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 十三年，又改監、少監為令、少令。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Supervisor and Deputy Supervisor were again renamed Director and Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Supervisor and Deputy Supervisor were again renamed Director and Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 丞加品至從五品。

translations.literal: Assistant Directors were raised to Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Directors were raised to Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 少府監置監，從三品，少監，從四品，各一人。

translations.literal: The Directorate of the Inner Palace appointed one Supervisor of Secondary Third Rank and one Deputy Supervisor of Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of the Inner Palace appointed one Supervisor of Secondary Third Rank and one Deputy Supervisor of Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 丞從五品，二人。

translations.literal: Two Assistant Directors of Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Assistant Directors of Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 統左尚、右尚、內尚、司織、司染、鎧甲、弓弩、掌冶等署。

translations.literal: It oversaw the Left Workshop, Right Workshop, Inner Workshop, Weaving, Dyeing, Armor, Crossbow, and Metallurgy directorates.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw the Left Workshop, Right Workshop, Inner Workshop, Weaving, Dyeing, Armor, Crossbow, and Metallurgy directorates.

sentences.zh: 複改監、少監為令、少令。

translations.literal: Supervisor and Deputy Supervisor were again renamed Director and Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor and Deputy Supervisor were again renamed Director and Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 並司織、司染為織染署，廢鎧甲、弓弩二署。

translations.literal: Weaving and Dyeing were combined into the Weaving and Dyeing Directorate; Armor and Crossbow directorates were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Weaving and Dyeing were combined into the Weaving and Dyeing Directorate; Armor and Crossbow directorates were abolished.

sentences.zh: 都水監改為使者，增為正五品，丞為從七品。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Waterways was changed to Commissioner, raised to Regular Fifth Rank; Assistant Director to Secondary Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterways was changed to Commissioner, raised to Regular Fifth Rank; Assistant Director to Secondary Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 統舟楫、河渠二署。

translations.literal: It oversaw the Shipping and River Works directorates.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw the Shipping and River Works directorates.

sentences.zh: 舟楫署每津置尉一人。

translations.literal: The Shipping Directorate appointed one Commandant at each ferry.
translations.idiomatic: The Shipping Directorate appointed one Commandant at each ferry.

sentences.zh: 五年，又改使者為監，四品，加置少監，為五品。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Commissioner was again changed to Supervisor, Fourth Rank; a Deputy Supervisor of Fifth Rank was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Commissioner was again changed to Supervisor, Fourth Rank; a Deputy Supervisor of Fifth Rank was added.

sentences.zh: 後又改監、少監為令，從三品，少令，從四品。

translations.literal: Later Supervisor and Deputy Supervisor were again renamed Director of Secondary Third Rank and Vice Director of Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Later Supervisor and Deputy Supervisor were again renamed Director of Secondary Third Rank and Vice Director of Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 長秋監置令一人，正四品，少令一人，從五品，丞二人，正七品。

translations.literal: The Directorate of the Inner Palace Household appointed one Director of Regular Fourth Rank and one Vice Director of Secondary Fifth Rank, and two Assistant Directors of Regular Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of the Inner Palace Household appointed one Director of Regular Fourth Rank and one Vice Director of Secondary Fifth Rank, and two Assistant Directors of Regular Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 並用士人。

translations.literal: All were commoners.
translations.idiomatic: All were commoners.

sentences.zh: 改內常侍為內承奉，置二人，正五品；

translations.literal: Regular Palace Attendants were renamed Inner Attendants-in-Chief, with two appointed, Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Regular Palace Attendants were renamed Inner Attendants-in-Chief, with two appointed, Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 給事為內承直，置四人，從五品。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretaries were renamed Inner Attendants Direct, with four appointed, Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretaries were renamed Inner Attendants Direct, with four appointed, Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 並用宦者。

translations.literal: All were eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: All were eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 罷內謁者官，領掖庭、宮闈、奚官等三署，並參用士人。

translations.literal: Palace Usher offices were abolished; the Palace Women, Inner Palace Gates, and Servant Women directorates were overseen, all using commoners jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Usher offices were abolished; the Palace Women, Inner Palace Gates, and Servant Women directorates were overseen, all using commoners jointly.

sentences.zh: 後又置內謁者員。

translations.literal: Palace Usher posts were later restored.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Usher posts were later restored.

sentences.zh: 十二衛，各置大將軍一人，將軍二人，總府事，並統諸鷹揚府。

translations.literal: The twelve guard offices each appointed one Grand General and two Generals to manage office affairs, and all oversaw the various Hawk-Proud offices.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve guard offices each appointed one Grand General and two Generals to manage office affairs, and all oversaw the various Hawk-Proud offices.

sentences.zh: 改驃騎為鷹揚郎將，正五品；

translations.literal: General of Fast Cavalry was renamed Hawk-Proud Commandant Lang, Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: General of Fast Cavalry was renamed Hawk-Proud Commandant Lang, Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 車騎為鷹揚副郎將，從五品；

translations.literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry was renamed Hawk-Proud Deputy Commandant Lang, Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: General of Chariots and Cavalry was renamed Hawk-Proud Deputy Commandant Lang, Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 大都督為校尉；

translations.literal: Great Area Commander was renamed Captain.
translations.idiomatic: Great Area Commander was renamed Captain.

sentences.zh: 帥都督為旅帥；

translations.literal: Commandant Commander was renamed Brigade Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Commander was renamed Brigade Commander.

sentences.zh: 都督為隊正，增置隊副以貳之。

translations.literal: Commander was renamed Squad Chief, and Squad Deputies were added as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Commander was renamed Squad Chief, and Squad Deputies were added as deputies.

sentences.zh: 改三衛為三侍。

translations.literal: The Three Guards were renamed Three Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Guards were renamed Three Attendants.

sentences.zh: 其直閤將軍、直寢、奉車都尉、駙馬都尉、直齋、別將、統軍、軍主、幢主之屬，並廢。

translations.literal: Direct-Pavilion Generals, Direct-Quarters, Commandants of Chariots in Attendance, Commandants of the Horse Guard, Direct-Fast, Separate Commanders, Army Commanders, Army Chiefs, and Banner Chiefs and the like were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Direct-Pavilion Generals, Direct-Quarters, Commandants of Chariots in Attendance, Commandants of the Horse Guard, Direct-Fast, Separate Commanders, Army Commanders, Army Chiefs, and Banner Chiefs and the like were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 以武候府司辰師員，隸為太史局官。

translations.literal: Timekeepers of the Martial Patrol office were placed under the Grand Astrologer Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Timekeepers of the Martial Patrol office were placed under the Grand Astrologer Bureau.

sentences.zh: 其軍士，左右衛所領名為驍騎，左右驍衛所領名豹騎，左右武衛所領名熊渠，左右屯衛所領名羽林，左右禦所領名射聲，左右候衛所領名佽飛，而總號衛士，每衛置護軍四人，掌副貳將軍。

translations.literal: The soldiers: those under the Left and Right Guards were called Valiant Cavalry; under the Left and Right Valiant Guards, Leopard Cavalry; under the Left and Right Martial Guards, Bear Channel; under the Left and Right Garrison Guards, Forest of Feathers; under the Left and Right Imperial Guards, Sound of Shooting; under the Left and Right Patrol Guards, Flying Attendants—and all were collectively called Guard Soldiers. Each guard office appointed four Protector Generals to assist the Generals.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers: those under the Left and Right Guards were called Valiant Cavalry; under the Left and Right Valiant Guards, Leopard Cavalry; under the Left and Right Martial Guards, Bear Channel; under the Left and Right Garrison Guards, Forest of Feathers; under the Left and Right Imperial Guards, Sound of Shooting; under the Left and Right Patrol Guards, Flying Attendants—and all were collectively called Guard Soldiers. Each guard office appointed four Protector Generals to assist the Generals.

sentences.zh: 將軍無則一人攝。

translations.literal: When there was no General, one person acted in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: When there was no General, one person acted in his stead.

sentences.zh: 尋改護軍為武賁郎將，正四品，而置武牙郎將六人，副焉，從四品。

translations.literal: Soon Protector General was renamed Martial Tiger Commandant Lang, Regular Fourth Rank; six Martial Fang Commandant Lang were appointed as deputies, Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Protector General was renamed Martial Tiger Commandant Lang, Regular Fourth Rank; six Martial Fang Commandant Lang were appointed as deputies, Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 諸衛皆置長史，從五品。

translations.literal: All guard offices appointed Chief Clerks of Secondary Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: All guard offices appointed Chief Clerks of Secondary Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 又有錄事參軍，司倉、兵、騎、鎧等員。

translations.literal: There were also Recorder Aides-de-Camp and Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: There were also Recorder Aides-de-Camp and Granary, Military, Cavalry, and Armor bureaus.

sentences.zh: 翊衛又加有親侍。

translations.literal: Escort Guard also had Personal Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Escort Guard also had Personal Attendants.

sentences.zh: 鷹揚府每府置鷹揚郎將一人，正五品，副鷹揚郎將一人，從五品，各有司馬及兵、倉兩司。

translations.literal: Each Hawk-Proud office appointed one Hawk-Proud Commandant Lang of Regular Fifth Rank and one Deputy Hawk-Proud Commandant Lang of Secondary Fifth Rank, each with a Marshal and Granary and Military bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Each Hawk-Proud office appointed one Hawk-Proud Commandant Lang of Regular Fifth Rank and one Deputy Hawk-Proud Commandant Lang of Secondary Fifth Rank, each with a Marshal and Granary and Military bureaus.

sentences.zh: 其府領親、勳、武三侍，非翊衛府，皆無三侍。

translations.literal: The office oversaw Personal, Meritorious, and Martial Attendants; non-Escort Guard offices had no Three Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: The office oversaw Personal, Meritorious, and Martial Attendants; non-Escort Guard offices had no Three Attendants.

sentences.zh: 鷹揚每府置越騎校尉二人，掌騎士，步兵校尉二人，領步兵，並正六品。

translations.literal: Each Hawk-Proud office appointed two Crossbow Cavalry Captains of Regular Sixth Rank to command cavalry, and two Infantry Captains to command infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Each Hawk-Proud office appointed two Crossbow Cavalry Captains of Regular Sixth Rank to command cavalry, and two Infantry Captains to command infantry.

sentences.zh: 外軍鷹揚官並同。

translations.literal: External army Hawk-Proud offices followed the same pattern.
translations.idiomatic: External army Hawk-Proud offices followed the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 左右候衛增置察非掾二人，專糾彈之事。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Patrol Guards added two Wrongdoing Investigators, charged exclusively with impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Patrol Guards added two Wrongdoing Investigators, charged exclusively with impeachment.

sentences.zh: 五年，又改副郎將並為鷹擊郎將。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Deputy Commandant Lang were all renamed Hawk-Strike Commandant Lang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Deputy Commandant Lang were all renamed Hawk-Strike Commandant Lang.

sentences.zh: 左右領左右府，改為左右備身府，各置備身郎將一人。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Command offices were renamed Left and Right Bodyguard offices, each with one Bodyguard Commandant Lang.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Command offices were renamed Left and Right Bodyguard offices, each with one Bodyguard Commandant Lang.

sentences.zh: 又各置直齋二人以貳之，並正四品，掌侍衛左右。

translations.literal: Two Direct-Fast officers were also appointed to each as deputies, Regular Fourth Rank, attending the emperor at left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Two Direct-Fast officers were also appointed to each as deputies, Regular Fourth Rank, attending the emperor at left and right.

sentences.zh: 統千牛左右、司射左右各十六人，並正六品。

translations.literal: They oversaw sixteen Thousand-Ox Left and Right and Archery Left and Right officers each, all Regular Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: They oversaw sixteen Thousand-Ox Left and Right and Archery Left and Right officers each, all Regular Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 千牛掌執千牛刀宿衛，司射掌供禦弓箭。

translations.literal: Thousand-Ox officers wielded Thousand-Ox swords on night guard; Archery officers supplied imperial bows and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Thousand-Ox officers wielded Thousand-Ox swords on night guard; Archery officers supplied imperial bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 置長史，正六品，錄事，司兵、倉、騎，參軍等員，並正八品。

translations.literal: Chief Clerks of Regular Sixth Rank, Recorders, and Granary, Military, Cavalry Aides-de-Camp and others, all Regular Eighth Rank, were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerks of Regular Sixth Rank, Recorders, and Granary, Military, Cavalry Aides-de-Camp and others, all Regular Eighth Rank, were appointed.

sentences.zh: 有折衝郎將，各三人，正四品，掌領驍果。

translations.literal: There were Repelling Foe Commandant Lang, three each, Regular Fourth Rank, commanding the Valiant Fruit corps.
translations.idiomatic: There were Repelling Foe Commandant Lang, three each, Regular Fourth Rank, commanding the Valiant Fruit corps.

sentences.zh: 又各置果毅郎將三人以貳之，從四品。

translations.literal: Three Fruit-Strength Commandant Lang were also appointed to each as deputies, Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Three Fruit-Strength Commandant Lang were also appointed to each as deputies, Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 其驍果，置左、右雄武府雄武郎將以領之。

translations.literal: For the Valiant Fruit corps, Left and Right Heroic Martial offices with Heroic Martial Commandant Lang were established to command them.
translations.idiomatic: For the Valiant Fruit corps, Left and Right Heroic Martial offices with Heroic Martial Commandant Lang were established to command them.

sentences.zh: 以武勇郎將為副員，同鷹揚、鷹擊。

translations.literal: Martial Valor Commandant Lang served as deputies, the same as Hawk-Proud and Hawk-Strike.
translations.idiomatic: Martial Valor Commandant Lang served as deputies, the same as Hawk-Proud and Hawk-Strike.

sentences.zh: 有司兵、司騎二局，並置參軍事。

translations.literal: There were Military and Cavalry bureaus, each with Aides-de-Camp appointed.
translations.idiomatic: There were Military and Cavalry bureaus, each with Aides-de-Camp appointed.

sentences.zh: 左右監門府，改將軍為郎將，各置一人，正四品，直閣各六人，正五品。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Gate Guard offices renamed Generals to Commandant Lang, one each, Regular Fourth Rank; six Direct-Pavilion officers each, Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Gate Guard offices renamed their Generals to Commandant Lang, one per office at Regular Fourth Rank, with six Direct-Pavilion officers each at Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 置官屬，並同備身府。

translations.literal: Office staff were organized the same as the Bodyguard offices.
translations.idiomatic: Their office staff matched the Bodyguard offices in organization.

sentences.zh: 又增左右門尉員一百二十人，正六品；

translations.literal: Left and Right Gate Commandant posts were increased by one hundred twenty, Regular Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred twenty additional Left and Right Gate Commandants were appointed at Regular Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 置門候員二百四十人，正七品。

translations.literal: Gate Attendant posts, two hundred forty, Regular Seventh Rank, were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred forty Gate Attendants were appointed at Regular Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 並分掌門禁守衛。

translations.literal: All divided gate security and guard duties.
translations.idiomatic: They divided responsibility for gate security and guard duty.

sentences.zh: 門下坊減內舍人、洗馬員，各置二人，減侍醫，置二人。

translations.literal: The Chancellery Ward reduced Inner Gentlemen Attendants and Study Companions to two each, and Attending Physicians to two.
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellery Ward cut Inner Gentlemen Attendants and Study Companions to two each and Attending Physicians to two.

sentences.zh: 改門大夫為宮門監，正字為正書。

translations.literal: Grand Masters of the Palace Gates were renamed Palace Gate Supervisors; Standardizers were renamed Correctors.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Masters of the Palace Gates became Palace Gate Supervisors, and Standardizers became Correctors.

sentences.zh: 典書坊改太子舍人為管記舍人，減置四人，改通事舍人為宣令舍人，為八員。

translations.literal: The Secretariat Ward renamed Gentlemen Attendants of the Crown Prince as Record-Managing Gentlemen Attendants, reduced to four; Gentlemen for General Service were renamed Edict-Proclaiming Gentlemen Attendants, eight in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat Ward renamed the Crown Prince's Gentlemen Attendants as Record-Managing Gentlemen Attendants, reduced to four, and renamed Gentlemen for General Service as Edict-Proclaiming Gentlemen Attendants, eight in all.

sentences.zh: 家令改為司府令，內坊承直改為典直。

translations.literal: Steward was renamed Director of the Palace Office; Inner Ward Duty Assistant Director was renamed Ward Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Steward became Director of the Palace Office, and the Inner Ward Duty Assistant Director became Ward Director.

sentences.zh: 左右衛率改為左右侍率，正四品。

translations.literal: Left and Right Guard Commandants were renamed Left and Right Attendant Commandants, Regular Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Guard Commandants were renamed Left and Right Attendant Commandants at Regular Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 改親衛為功曹，勳衛為義曹，翊衛為良曹。

translations.literal: Personal Guard was renamed Merit Officer; Meritorious Guard was renamed Righteousness Officer; Escort Guard was renamed Goodness Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Personal Guard became Merit Officer, Meritorious Guard became Righteousness Officer, and Escort Guard became Goodness Officer.

sentences.zh: 罷直齋、直閣員。

translations.literal: Direct-Fast and Direct-Pavilion posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Direct-Fast and Direct-Pavilion posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 左右宗衛率改為左右武侍率，正四品。

translations.literal: Left and Right Imperial Clan Guard Commandants were renamed Left and Right Martial Attendant Commandants, Regular Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Imperial Clan Guard Commandants were renamed Left and Right Martial Attendant Commandants at Regular Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 左右虞候開府改為左右虞候率，正四品，並置副率。

translations.literal: Left and Right Patrol Guard Grand Offices were renamed Left and Right Patrol Commandants, Regular Fourth Rank; Deputy Commandants were also appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Patrol Guard Grand Offices became Left and Right Patrol Commandants at Regular Fourth Rank, with Deputy Commandants also appointed.

sentences.zh: 左右內率降為正五品。

translations.literal: Left and Right Inner Commandants were reduced to Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Inner Commandants were reduced to Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 千牛備身改為司仗左右，備身左右改為主射左右。

translations.literal: Thousand-Ox Bodyguards were renamed Left and Right Arms Officers; Left and Right Bodyguards were renamed Left and Right Archery Officers.
translations.idiomatic: Thousand-Ox Bodyguards became Left and Right Arms Officers, and Left and Right Bodyguards became Left and Right Archery Officers.

sentences.zh: 各員八人。

translations.literal: Eight each.
translations.idiomatic: Eight of each were appointed.

sentences.zh: 左右監門率改為宮門將，降為正五品。

translations.literal: Left and Right Gate Guard Commandants were renamed Palace Gate Generals, reduced to Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Gate Guard Commandants were renamed Palace Gate Generals and reduced to Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 監門直長改為直事，置六十人。

translations.literal: Gate Guard Duty Chiefs were renamed Duty Officers, with sixty appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Gate Guard Duty Chiefs were renamed Duty Officers, with sixty appointed.

sentences.zh: 開皇中，置國王，郡王，國公，郡公，縣公、侯、伯、子、男為九等者，至是唯留王、公、侯三等。

translations.literal: In the Kaihuang reign, Prince of a State, Prince of a Commandery, Duke of a State, Duke of a Commandery, Duke of a County, Marquis, Earl, Viscount, and Baron were established as nine ranks; now only Prince, Duke, and Marquis—three ranks—were retained.
translations.idiomatic: Under Kaihuang, nine noble ranks had been established from Prince of a State down to Baron; now only Prince, Duke, and Marquis—three ranks—remained.

sentences.zh: 餘並廢之。

translations.literal: All the rest were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: All other ranks were abolished.

sentences.zh: 王府諸司參軍，更名諸司書佐，屬參軍則直以屬為名。

translations.literal: Various bureau Aides-de-Camp of princely estates were renamed bureau Secretaries; Assistant Aides-de-Camp were simply named after their bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Princely estate bureau Aides-de-Camp were renamed bureau Secretaries, and Assistant Aides-de-Camp took the name of their bureau.

sentences.zh: 改國令為家令。

translations.literal: State Director was renamed Steward.
translations.idiomatic: State Director was renamed Steward.

sentences.zh: 自余以國為名者，皆去之。

translations.literal: All others using the word State in their titles had it removed.
translations.idiomatic: All other titles containing the word State dropped it.

sentences.zh: 行宮所在，皆立總監以司之。

translations.literal: Wherever imperial traveling palaces were located, Grand Supervisors were established to manage them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Supervisors were established at every imperial traveling palace to manage its affairs.

sentences.zh: 上宮正五品，中宮從五品，下宮正七品。

translations.literal: Upper palace: Regular Fifth Rank; middle palace: Secondary Fifth Rank; lower palace: Regular Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper palaces ranked Regular Fifth, middle palaces Secondary Fifth, and lower palaces Regular Seventh.

sentences.zh: 隴右諸牧，置左、右牧監各一人，以司統之。

translations.literal: For the various pastures of Longyou, Left and Right Pasture Supervisors were appointed, one each, to oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Pasture Supervisors, one each, were appointed to oversee the Longyou pastures.

sentences.zh: 罷州置郡，郡置太守。

translations.literal: Prefectures were abolished and commanderies restored; commanderies had Grand Administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures were abolished, commanderies restored, and each commandery received a Grand Administrator.

sentences.zh: 上郡從三品，中郡正四品，下郡從四品。

translations.literal: Upper commanderies: Secondary Third Rank; middle commanderies: Regular Fourth Rank; lower commanderies: Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Upper commanderies ranked Secondary Third, middle commanderies Regular Fourth, and lower commanderies Secondary Fourth.

sentences.zh: 京兆、河南則俱為尹，並正三品。

translations.literal: Jingzhao and Henan both had Prefects, Regular Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao and Henan each had a Prefect at Regular Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 罷長史、司馬，置贊務一人以貳之。

translations.literal: Chief Administrator and Administrator were abolished; one Assistant Administrator was appointed as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Administrator and Administrator were abolished, and one Assistant Administrator served as deputy.

sentences.zh: 京兆、河南從四品，上郡正五品，中郡從五品，下郡正六品。

translations.literal: Jingzhao and Henan: Secondary Fourth Rank; upper commanderies: Regular Fifth Rank; middle commanderies: Secondary Fifth Rank; lower commanderies: Regular Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao and Henan ranked Secondary Fourth; upper commanderies Regular Fifth; middle commanderies Secondary Fifth; and lower commanderies Regular Sixth.

sentences.zh: 次置東西曹掾，京兆、河南從五品，上郡正六品，中郡從六品，下郡正七品。

translations.literal: Next, Eastern and Western Bureau Secretaries were appointed: Jingzhao and Henan, Secondary Fifth Rank; upper commanderies, Regular Sixth Rank; middle commanderies, Secondary Sixth Rank; lower commanderies, Regular Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern and Western Bureau Secretaries followed: Jingzhao and Henan at Secondary Fifth, upper commanderies at Regular Sixth, middle commanderies at Secondary Sixth, and lower commanderies at Regular Seventh.

sentences.zh: 主簿，司功、倉、戶、兵、法、士曹等書佐，各因郡之大小而為增減。

translations.literal: Chief Secretaries and Secretaries for Merit, Granary, Household, Military, Law, and Scholar bureaus were increased or reduced according to the size of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Secretaries and bureau Secretaries for Merit, Granary, Household, Military, Law, and Scholar affairs were adjusted according to commandery size.

sentences.zh: 改行參軍為行書佐。

translations.literal: Acting Aides-de-Camp were renamed Acting Secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Aides-de-Camp were renamed Acting Secretaries.

sentences.zh: 舊有兵處，則刺史帶諸軍事以統之，至是別置都尉，副都尉。

translations.literal: Where troops had previously been stationed, Regional Inspectors concurrently held military command to oversee them; now separate Area Commandants and Deputy Area Commandants were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Where troops were stationed, Regional Inspectors had previously held concurrent military command; now separate Area Commandants and Deputy Area Commandants were appointed.

sentences.zh: 都尉正四品，領兵，與郡不相知。

translations.literal: Area Commandants were Regular Fourth Rank, commanding troops, independent of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Area Commandants ranked Regular Fourth, commanded troops, and operated independently of the commandery.

sentences.zh: 副都尉正五品。

translations.literal: Deputy Area Commandants were Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Area Commandants ranked Regular Fifth.

sentences.zh: 又置京輔都尉，從三品，立府於潼關，主兵領遏。

translations.literal: Capital Region Area Commandants were also appointed, Secondary Third Rank, with offices established at Tong Pass to command troops and block passage.
translations.idiomatic: Capital Region Area Commandants were also appointed at Secondary Third Rank, with offices at Tong Pass to command troops and control passage.

sentences.zh: 並置副都尉，從四品。

translations.literal: Deputy Area Commandants were also appointed, Secondary Fourth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Area Commandants were also appointed at Secondary Fourth Rank.

sentences.zh: 又置諸防主、副官，掌同諸鎮。

translations.literal: Chiefs and Deputies of the various defensive posts were also appointed, with duties the same as garrison commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Chiefs and Deputies were also appointed at the various defensive posts, with duties matching those of garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 大興、長安、河南、洛陽四縣令，並增為正五品。

translations.literal: Magistrates of Daxing, Chang'an, Henan, and Luoyang were all raised to Regular Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates of Daxing, Chang'an, Henan, and Luoyang were all promoted to Regular Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 諸縣皆以所管閑劇及衝要以為等級。

translations.literal: All counties were graded according to the busyness or leisure and strategic importance of their jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: All counties were graded by the workload and strategic importance of their jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 丞、主簿如故。

translations.literal: Assistant Directors and Chief Secretaries remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Directors and Chief Secretaries remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 其後諸郡各加置通守一人，位次太守，京兆、河南，則謂之內史。

translations.literal: Later each commandery added one General Administrator, ranking below the Grand Administrator; for Jingzhao and Henan he was called Inner Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Later each commandery gained a General Administrator below the Grand Administrator; in Jingzhao and Henan this officer was called Inner Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 又改郡贊務為丞，位在通守下，縣尉為縣正，尋改正為戶曹、法曹，分司以承郡之六司。

translations.literal: Commandery Assistant Administrators were renamed Assistant Directors, ranking below the General Administrator; County Commandants were renamed County Chiefs; soon renamed Household Bureau and Law Bureau, dividing duties to handle the commandery's six bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Commandery Assistant Administrators became Assistant Directors below the General Administrator; County Commandants became County Chiefs, soon renamed Household Bureau and Law Bureau to divide the commandery's six bureaus.

sentences.zh: 河南、洛陽、長安、大興，則加置功曹，而為三司，司各二人。

translations.literal: Henan, Luoyang, Chang'an, and Daxing added Merit Officers, making three bureaus, two officers each.
translations.idiomatic: Henan, Luoyang, Chang'an, and Daxing added Merit Officers, forming three bureaus with two officers each.

sentences.zh: 郡縣佛寺，改為道場，道觀改為玄壇，各置監、丞。

translations.literal: Buddhist temples in commanderies and counties were renamed Dharma Fields; Daoist temples were renamed Mystic Altars; each had a Supervisor and Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist temples in commanderies and counties became Dharma Fields, Daoist temples became Mystic Altars, and each had a Supervisor and Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 京都諸坊改為裡，皆省除裡司，官以主其事。

translations.literal: Capital wards were renamed Lanes; all Lane officials were abolished, and officials were appointed to manage the affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Capital wards were renamed Lanes, Lane officials were abolished, and appointed officials managed their affairs.

sentences.zh: 帝自三年定令之後，驟有制置，制置未久，隨複改易。

translations.literal: After the emperor fixed the statutes in the third year, there were frequent ad hoc establishments; scarcely established, they were soon changed again.
translations.idiomatic: After the emperor fixed the statutes in the third year, offices were constantly created and revised almost as soon as they were established.

sentences.zh: 其餘不可備知者，蓋史之闕文雲。

translations.literal: What else cannot be fully known is probably where the history has gaps.
translations.idiomatic: What remains unknown is probably lost to gaps in the historical record.
